monologue: A man was arrested at the JFK airport with cocaine hidden inside bottles of nail polish and sticks of deodorant. The man might have gotten away with it if he hadn't hidden the drugs inside two other things you can't bring through airport security.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Police in California just burned 34,000 marijuana plants that were growing in a state park. The police were very angry about finding all that weed until the wind changed direction.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Arbroath, Scotland, is famous for two things. It's the ancient capital of Scotland and it's where are where you get Arbroath Smokies. The Arbroath Smokie is a national treasure. It's the tastiest morsel to come out of Scotland since Susan Boyle.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The Arbroath Smokie is a fish. They salt it overnight and hang it in a big Smokie barrel. They end up so tender they literally melt in your mouth. Going to Arbroath without trying a Smokie would be like going to New York without trying the pizza or going to Miami without trying the cocaine.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: You should never confuse a Smokie with a Snooki.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: When I came to Arbroath when I was about 10 years old, I remember it being a dark and rainy town. I'm beginning to suspect that Scotland isn't dark and rainy, that it's just my memories that are dark and rainy.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Barack Obama supports same-sex marriage. Mitt Romney doesn't even support same-sex car pools.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A Republican official says that Mitt Romney should pick "an incredibly boring white guy as running mate." When he heard that, Joe Biden said, "Thanks, I've already got a gig."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Facebook founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg turned 28 this week. He got a watch from his girlfriend, a sweater from his parents, and from the rest of us, all of our credit card numbers.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The Dalai Lama is saying that China trained a woman to assassinate him by putting poison in her hair. Luckily, the Dalai Lama had recently just stopped eating hair.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A janitor has graduated from Columbia University with honors as a classics major. With his new degree in classics, he's now qualified to become a janitor.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: President Obama released his financial disclosure statement today. It turns out he is now worth over $10 million. So at least somebody is doing well in this economy.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Justice Department has launched a probe into JPMorgan's $2.3 billion loss. I believe it's called "Operation wink, nod, and look the other way."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: President Obama is calling for more government reform after JPMorgan's $2 billion loss. Really, is that what we need — the government stepping in? You know what's going to happen? The government's going to teach them how to lose $2 billion a DAY!

name: Jay Leno
monologue: According to a new book, Mick Jagger used prostitutes. But he always felt like he was being overcharged. He said he didn't like to pay them. That doesn't sound like a rock star, does it? It sounds more like a Secret Service agent.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A new poll found that Mitt Romney is actually ahead of President Obama among female voters. That explains Obama’s new slogan, “I’m Barack Obama, and I loved ‘50 Shades of Grey.’”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A new app tells your Facebook friends if you're not following your diet. Of course your friends could always figure it out that other way: looking at your photos on Facebook.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: There’s a new online reality show premiering this summer called “The Mormon Bachelor.” At the start of the show, the bachelor dates 25 contestants, and by the end he’s MARRIED 25 contestants.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Swedish researchers have discovered a new species of fish. Not to be outdone, Gummi researchers have discovered a new species of bear.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Virgin Atlantic announced that on a select number of flights, passengers will be able to use their cellphones to make calls. I think I would honestly rather they filled the plane with killer bees than allow this.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Only six passengers will be allowed to make calls at one time, which seems like too many. But Virgin said it will only be used for important calls, like calling to say, "Guess where I'm calling from. Yeah, the plane. I'm calling from the plane."

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Today Herman Cain endorsed Mitt Romney. This is possibly very important because as goes Herman Cain, so go the other two black Republicans in America.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Ron Paul made an announcement on Monday, saying he's dropping out of the race for president. This was his third race for president. He ran in 2008 against John McCain and against Lincoln in 1860.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new J.C. Penny catalog features a gay couple. This is historic. It's the first time anyone gay has been spotted wearing clothes from J.C. Penny.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Cher sent out a tweet that got some attention. She said if Mitt Romney gets elected, she doesn't know if she can breathe the same air as him. In the event that Romney does get elected, I want to offer Cher a place to live. It's the Cher biodome, complete with a year supply of air and Rice-A-Roni where Cher can live, be happy, and have peace.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: If you didn't for any reason laugh at the Cher biodome joke, it's probably for two reasons. One, it's not that funny. And two, if you're a younger viewer, you have no idea who Cher is.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Florida's board of education has decided to lower the passing grade on standardized tests after noticing a drastic drop in student passing scores. In other words, if the students don't do well enough on the tests, they don't teach them better, they just lower the bar. Why didn't we think of this before? Imagine how many more doctors we could've had right now.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Newsweek magazine has President Obama on the cover this week, calling him the first gay president. Actually, that's not true. Historians say that James Buchanan was probably our first gay president. He was a bachelor, he lived for 15 years with an Alabama senator, and he was briefly married to Liza Minnelli.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: JPMorgan lost $3 billion in their first quarter and today they lost yet another $1 billion. Turns out they bet on the Lakers.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I don't know what JPMorgan is doing. They announced today they are moving their entire headquarters to Greece.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: During a speech in Ohio, Joe Biden criticized Republicans for not understanding the middle class. In response, Mitt Romney was like, "That's ridiculous. Some of my best friends' gardeners are middle class.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: CNN's ratings hit a 15-year low this week. In fact, things are so bad at CNN, Wolf Blitzer started renting out "The Situation Room" for birthday parties.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: According to a new report from NASA, at this very moment there are about 4,700 asteroids that are big enough and close enough to pose a threat to life on earth, which is where we live. I wish Arnold Schwarzenegger was still governor. He would know what to do.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Scientists at NASA say the asteroids are dangerously aligned with the earth's orbit and are large enough to enter our atmosphere without breaking apart. But they also say we shouldn't panic. You know, if you didn't want us to panic, maybe you shouldn't have put out a press release saying there were 4,700 asteroids hurtling toward the earth.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: NASA says the odds that the asteroids will hit us are slim. They are somewhere between Victoria Beckham and the thinner of the Olsen twins.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: The Wiggles have announced that three of the original four members are leaving the group. The purple one, the yellow one, and the red one are all leaving at the end of the year. Their plan is to eventually form a very colorful group of homeless people.

name: David Letterman
monologue: It's the 85th Anniversary of Lindbergh's solo transatlantic flight. Coincidentally, it's the last time an American was greeted warmly in France.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: On the first day of trading, Facebook shares rose less than expected. We were promised that Facebook would take off like a rocket. Apparently it's a North Korean rocket.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Facebook started at 38 bucks a share. They thought it would go to 70, 80, 90 — but it's still at 38. Experts say Facebook did not live up to the hype. Big deal, NBC does that every fall.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Experts say people would have bought the stock but they're too busy checking their Facebook.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Have you heard about Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin? He's renounced his U.S. citizenship because it'll save him millions of dollars of taxes — to which Mitt Romney said, "That's what the Cayman Islands are for."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: This week Mitt Romney started giving speeches while standing in front of a giant U.S. debt clock. When asked what it was like campaigning with a large electronic object, the debt clock was like, “Not bad.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: “American Idol” is down to its final two contestants. The losing contestant will fade away into obscurity, while the winning contestant won’t have that happen until around June.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: An aquarium in the U.K. claims that it has the world’s first vegetarian shark. Either that or they’re playing a really mean prank on Nigel the tank cleaner.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: There's something very rare happening this weekend — a solar eclipse. Specifically, it's the one that looks like a ring of fire. The last time one of these eclipses was visible in the United States was 1994, when the music group Ace of Base ruled the charts. We know how that worked out.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I know they say you're not supposed to look at a solar eclipse, but I'm looking at it. I'm going to look right at it. I don't care. I do what I want.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Facebook sold $16 billion worth of stock today, making it the largest initial public offering for an American company ever. Facebook is now valued at $104 billion. More than McDonald's, more than Disney. That's the company whose primary purpose thus far has been to update on what our former college roommate had for lunch.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Mark Zuckerberg personally made $1.5 billion today. That is more than I make in a year.

name: David Letterman
monologue: A 1920 Babe Ruth uniform sold at a sports memorabilia auction for $4 million. As a matter of fact, this is the uniform he was wearing when he was first dating Betty White.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Season seven of "Keeping Up With the Kardashians" premiered last night. I really thought I was caught up with them, but now I realize I'm not. It's such a busy time for the Kardashians right now with the show starting and the NBA playoffs, which as you know is their prime mating season.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Any of you see the eclipse yesterday? I've never met anyone with eye damage from an eclipse, but they talk about it all the time. And that proves something I've always suspected, that nature is trying to kill us. We have to fight back and kill it first.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: No one was more affected by the eclipse than the notorious tanning mom. Stupid moon stole five precious minutes of UV rays from her face and now she's never going to get those back.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Shares of Facebook stock dropped from the opening day price of $38 to around $34 today. They say if it drops any lower, Mitt Romney will swoop in and divide it up into Face and Book.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Mark Zuckerberg started Facebook in his Harvard dorm room and in eight years built it into the most popular waste of time the world has ever seen.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Al Gore has a new girlfriend. Apparently, it's getting pretty serious. He's already been over to bore her parents.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Gore and his girlfriend were spotted taking long walks on the beach, measuring how much the sea is rising.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: President Obama gave the commencement speech at Barnard College the other day. He told graduates their future is bright unless they want jobs.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Mark Zuckerberg and his girlfriend got married — one day after Facebook raised $16 billion on the stock market. Zuckerberg listed the 10 things he loves about her, while she listed the 16 billion things she loves about him.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Mark Zuckerberg got married. Their reception was annoying, though. Right when everyone got used to the seating arrangement, Zuckerberg changed the layout for no reason.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: President Obama tossed around a football at Soldier Field, home of the Chicago Bears. Obama told Biden to go long. Then, he hopped into his car and drove away.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Happy birthday to Mr. T, who turned 60 years old today. You can tell he is getting old. Today he pitied the fool who couldn't get Barry Manilow tickets.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Police discovered 800 pounds of marijuana in the waters off the coast, just floating in the water. The authorities are advising surfers to stay out of the water. There is nothing more dangerous than a shark with the munchies.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: A lot of people say they use Facebook to reconnect with old friends. No thanks. If I'm not friends with you anymore, there's probably a reason. And that reason is I owe you money.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Some people use Facebook to check up on ex-boyfriends or ex-girlfriends. That just seems creepy to me. I like it the old-fashioned way. If you want to check up on an ex, go through their trash.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Andy Warhol said that in the future everyone will be famous for 15 minutes. Facebook is exactly like that except you're not really famous and your 15 minutes goes on forever.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Mark Zuckerberg got married a couple of days ago. At their wedding, Zuckerberg's wife wore a dress that cost nearly $5,000. That is until the dress went public. Now it's worth $2,000.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new report suggests that Christopher Columbus may have secretly been Jewish. What tipped historians off was Columbus' diary entry where he described his journey to America as "a real schlep."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Bagged salads across the country have been recalled due to contamination fears. Luckily this is America, so none of the salads were touched. God help us if something happens to our Doritos supply.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Khloe Kardashian is refusing to take a paternity test to determine if she's actually a Kardashian. She said, "I think my record of fame without talent speaks for itself."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Facebook has lost so much money that founder Mark Zuckerberg has been named an honorary board member of JPMorgan.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Congratulations to former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi. The city of San Francisco has named a street after her today. It's called Botox Avenue.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Two new studies have found that people who snore have a higher risk of cancer. Although in most cases, the spouse will smother them with the pillow long before the cancer takes them.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Bad news for CNN. They just had their lowest rating in 15 years. Their ratings are so low that today Jesse Jackson turned them down for an interview.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The man who invented the TV remote has passed away at the age of 96. But here's what I'm wondering. Is he dead, or does someone just need to change his batteries?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: According to a survey, the second worst traffic is here in Los Angeles. I think traffic here actually moves pretty well. It only gets jammed up if something terrible happens, like a light drizzle.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I admit that I get angry in traffic when driving to work. But it's pointless. It's much better to bottle up that anger and then unleash it when you get to work.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The best way to avoid road rage is to relax. You can meditate, sing songs in your head, make a to-do list. Those are all tricks I developed while interviewing Regis Philbin.

name: David Letterman
monologue: DC Comics has announced that one of their superheroes may be gay. I've got my money on Dog Groomer Man.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: While attending meetings in Chicago this week, President Obama stayed at a hotel instead of his own house. It was annoying. When he asked for a wake-up call, they just showed him the latest poll numbers.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The Los Angeles Lakers were eliminated from the playoffs last night after just five games. Yeah, the Lakers fell fast — which explains their new name: the Los Angeles Facebook Stock.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: DC Comics announced that one of its existing superheroes will be reintroduced as gay. Or as Aquaman put it, “Why is everyone looking at me?”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: An 83-year-old man in the U.K. recently became the oldest living kidney donor in history — which is pretty cool unless you’re the guy who just got an 83-year-old kidney.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: One of the pioneers of TV passed away over the weekend. Eugene Polley, who invented the wireless remote control, died at the age of 96. He created the remote in 1955. Before that, if you wanted to change the channel, you had to scream at your wife in the kitchen to come and change it.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Polley died doing what he loved — not getting up.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Mitt Romney reminds me of the guy in the commercial that buys his wife a Lexus for Christmas with the big bow on it.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: There's a parking spot in the Greenwich Village area that will be priced at $1 million. I would love it if whoever buys this spot parks a 1986 Ford Taurus in it.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: An Arby's served a customer a sandwich with a piece of human finger inside. The manager apologized and gave the customer some free hair in his shake.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: That's one of those jokes where it's hard to get past the premise of the joke. Everyone is just thinking about the finger in the sandwich and thinking, how could you tell?

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Now I'm being told that Arby's is one of our sponsors. Well, I'll tell you how you can tell. One's a human finger. The other, the best-tasting sandwich you'll ever have.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new survey just came out and it finds that sex is better when you're on vacation. Yeah, at least that's what my wife emailed me from the Bahamas.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Police in South Dakota arrested a 53-year-old man formerly from Chicago who's trying to climb Mount Rushmore. The guy is in his 50s, from Chicago, and he's desperate to get on Mount Rushmore. Oh my God, it's Obama!

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Just two weeks after a felon in jail got 41 percent of the democratic vote in West Virginia, President Obama got embarrassed again in Arkansas yesterday when an unknown lawyer got 42 percent. See, that proves once and for all that there's only a 1 percent difference between a lawyer and a convicted felon.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Four Secret Service agents fired for that sex scandal decided to fight their dismissal. The lawyer said they didn't realize the women were prostitutes. Is that the best argument when you're trying to get your job back in the Secret Service? These guys are supposed to be experts at picking people out of a crowd. Can't spot a hooker? Really?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: A new study says that people who snore have a higher risk of cancer. But the good news is: Hey, at least they're not losing any sleep over it.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I was watching "The View" and Barbara Walters talked about losing her virginity. Call me old-fashioned, but I think that's none of our business. That should be between Barbara and King Arthur.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Yesterday on eBay, a buyer paid $18,000 for a pair of Queen Elizabeth's underpants. He said buying them was easy. The tough part was getting them off her.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: One of tonight's "American Idol" finalists is a young dude named Philip Phillips. He's either a finalist or the winner, I don't remember. The name Philip Phillips sounds like lazy parenting.

name: David Letterman
monologue: It's easy to be critical of the United States, and people love to try to take us down. But I want to tell you something. Here in the United States of America we produce more three-day weekends than any other country in the world.

monologue: Top Ten Things You Don't Want To Hear At A Barbecue

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Today, members of the Secret Service told the Senate that there’s an unwritten rule amongst agents that what happens on the road stays on the road. Not to be confused with that WRITTEN rule — that they shouldn't have sex with prostitutes.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Here’s an election update. Today Mitt Romney met with a group of wealthy Latino business owners. Or as Romney calls them, “the Juan percent.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A recent survey found that more men are finding work in fields that are historically dominated by women. I heard it from a nun at my church — Sister Gary.

monologue: After losing billions of dollars, Mark Zuckerberg is being sued for hiding Facebook’s weak financial report. Apparently he put it somewhere no one will ever look — MySpace.

monologue: Marvel Comics announced that their first openly gay superhero, a character called Northstar, is getting married. Mitt Romney came out against this because he believes marriage is a sacred bond between one super man and one super woman.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Tonight we witnessed the season finale of "American Idol," and when all the votes were counted after 19 weeks of competition, our new idol is Colin Crystal. Actually I just made that name up. There's no Colin Crystal. I have no idea who won. I don't watch.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I'm just happy to report that "American Idol" is done for another season.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Now that "American Idol" is done, Jennifer Lopez will go back to making three commercials a day while Steven Tyler returns to his day job as a mannequin.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: U2 singer Bono may have made over $1 billion from Facebook going public. A spokesman for U2 said the band is still going to tour but only because the drummer invested heavily in MySpace.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new study shows current members of Congress speak at a 10th grade level. When reached for comment, Congressman Eric Cantor said, "Nuh-uh!"

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new report just came out and it claims that good cholesterol may not be as beneficial as previously thought. This is really bad news for Domino's new good-cholesterol-stuffed pizza.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The Miss Universe pageant was last weekend and the transgender Miss Canada did not win. Apparently judges were not impressed by her talent — having an Adam's apple.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: We're excited because we have a new show premiere tonight here on ABC, a singing competition show. It's about time somebody did one of those.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Each of the new show's stars say they are in search of undiscovered talent, which I don't think we have anymore, to be honest with you. In fact, I think we should start forcing some of our existing celebrities back into obscurity.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Here's how a TV pitch meeting goes. "Ok, so, it's a singing competition, and . . ." "Stop right there, we love it. We're putting it on."

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: A new "American Idol" winner for the fourth year in a row is the white kid with the guitar. This one's name is Phillip Phillips. It will be hard to forget someone with that name, but I have every confidence that we will.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: It's been a rough week for Facebook and Mark Zuckerberg. Zuckerberg has lost so much money in the market that President Obama is going to have him replace Ben Bernanke.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Center for Responsive Politics reports that President Obama has become the first politician in history to raise $1 billion in his political career. Imagine how much more he could have raised if people hadn't lost it all in his economic plan?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: A Pakistani doctor who helped the CIA hunt for Osama bin Laden has been convicted of high treason in Pakistan. He was sentenced to 33 years in prison for helping us. Think how much worse the sentence would have been if Pakistan wasn't our ally.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: New research shows that eating organic foods can make people more arrogant and judgmental. In fact, eating just one handful of organic bean sprouts has the same effect as driving 1,000 miles in a Prius.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Britney Spears is planning to launch a new fragrance called Fantasy Twist. That sounds like something John Travolta gets at the end of a massage.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Happy birthday to Bob Dylan, who turned 71 years old today. When he made his wish, God was like, "No clue what he just said."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A Disney cruise employee is being investigated for stealing a passenger's iPhone. If he's found guilty, he'll be given a really tough punishment — eight more years working on that Disney cruise.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: In New York City it's Fleet Week. Navy ships dock so sailors can go into the Big Apple to party. I just hope the sailors remember to be careful on the streets of Manhattan. One wrong turn and they could find themselves backstage at a Broadway show.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The Navy was founded by a Scotsman. John Paul Jones was his name. Then he went on to play bass for Led Zeppelin.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Historians say Americans might have lost the Revolutionary War if John Paul Jones hadn't played a 20-minute Mellotron solo at the Battle of Brandywine.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The Navy always appealed to me because I always liked the submarine movies. My favorite is "The Hunt for Red October" where Sean Connery played a Russian who had a Scottish accent.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Next week Mitt Romney will campaign in Las Vegas with Donald Trump and Newt Gingrich. Did somebody say “The Hangover, Part III?”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: First lady Michelle Obama said that if she could trade places with anyone in the world, it would be Beyoncé. Of course it got awkward when Barack was like, “I’m game!”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Did you guys see this? Last night at the Twins-White Sox game in Chicago, Snoop Dogg threw out the first pitch. And as predicted, the pitch was pretty high.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: This week a solar-powered plane attempted to fly more than 1,500 miles. It was going great until the plane encountered one technical problem — night.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: It's Memorial Day, although it's not a good day for America's favorite Canadian, Justin Bieber. He's wanted for questioning by the Los Angeles sheriff's department. Apparently Bieber had an altercation with a photographer. Bieber went all Mel Gibson on some dude.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Now Justin's on the lam, considered armed and adorable.

monologue: President Obama is brewing his own beer in the White House. Actually, the White House beer is a lot like the Obama administration — great buzz, weak finish.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: An all-female rock band from Russia, in a Moscow cathedral, played a protest song about Vladimir Putin's ties to the church. Putin's henchmen tracked them down and threw them in prison. They were charged with hooliganism. Is that a crime? That's like being charged with tomfoolery. Or shenanigans.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: If you don't agree with Putin, you get sent to a gulag. Maybe they should've sung it ironically, sung about the fact that Putin got elected with 140 percent of the vote.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Some Russians are claiming that Putin's election was rigged and that he has no legitimate claim to power. You know what these Russians are called? Missing.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: When the band's members were sentenced, there was a huge protest in Moscow. One of the protesters was Garry Kasparov, the chess champion. He got roughed up by police. I don't know why. He's just a pawn in their game.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Here's what's great about America. You can now buy waffle-flavored vodka. See, good things are happening under Obama.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: I thought Mitt Romney's wife Ann did a good job at the Republican convention. During her speech, she said after they got married, she and Mitt lived in a basement. It was a 2-room basement on the French Riviera.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Chris Christie gave the keynote address. In his speech he said the word "I" 37 times, "Romney" 7 times, and "jobs" only once. And then there was the 622 times he said the word "ham."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Yesterday a medical marijuana group officially endorsed President Obama for president. Doesn't really help Obama though, because they were just getting around to endorsing him for 2008.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The oldest person on Facebook is a 101-year-old woman. She said, "I want to waste what little time I have left."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Did you all watch the Republican convention last night? It's good to see scripted television finally making a comeback.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Hurricane Isaac turned out to be not much of a threat to the Republican convention. But to their credit, the Republicans had a contingency plan. If the hurricane did hit hard, delegates were instructed to evacuate to Mitt Romney's tax shelter.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: According to The New York Times, more than half of President Obama's Twitter followers are fake. They don't even exist. Which is actually a good thing because if they did exist there wouldn't be any jobs for them.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The White House is now brewing its own beer. Republicans say the White House beer is actually pretty good. Just don't drink the Kool-Aid.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The Republican National Convention is in full swing in Tampa. Speeches are being made. Hats flown in the air. Everyone gets their own hippie to slap around.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Working out has given Paul Ryan phenomenal abs. His abs are so in demand that TMZ is offering a bounty for anyone who can get an in-focus shot.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: You can think outside the box and pick someone who'll excite people like Sarah Palin or you can play it safe with an honest down-home family man like John Edwards.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I can't wait to see the debate between Ryan and Joe Biden. Biden is said to be already trying out different strategies. So far the one that Obama likes is where Biden pretends to have food poisoning and they cancel the debate.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Are you excited about Labor Day weekend? That's a holiday where Americans take three days off from looking for a job.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Tonight is the last night, the final night of the Republican convention. Tonight is the swimsuit competition.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: It's been reported the Republican convention decided not to show a hologram of Ronald Reagan for fear it would overshadow Mitt Romney. It's never a good sign when your candidate is in danger of being overshadowed by something that technically doesn't make a shadow.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A former Navy SEAL has a book out that claims Osama bin Laden was unarmed when he was shot. The book is called "Who Cares, He's Dead."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: MTV has announced this will be the last season of "Jersey Shore." So I guess we'll never know if they learn to walk upright.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Clint Eastwood was the mystery guest tonight at the Republican convention. Finally, a senior citizen who scares Paul Ryan.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: A man in Florida has been arrested for wearing a President Obama mask while robbing a McDonald's. To show you how good this guy's disguise was, instead of a holdup note he was reading from a teleprompter.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: This Obama robber made some pretty scary threats to the McDonald's employees. He said, "Give me your money, or else my economic plan will have you working here for the rest of your life."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: A company announced they are now selling waffle-flavored vodka. Who is this for, the drunks that still think breakfast is the most important meal of the day?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: At the convention tonight, the surprise speaker was Clint Eastwood. What's more surprising than a grumpy old white guy at the Republican convention?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Forbes magazine released the highest paid celebrities list. Right now in Hollywood, self-centered jerks are flipping through Forbes, seeing who's on the list so they know who to suck up to.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Forbes is run by billionaire Steve Forbes. Who names a magazine after himself? Who would do that? Oprah.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Forbes once ran for president. It lasted about a week. So who better to judge the others' success?

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: If you're a donor to President Obama's campaign, you were promised exclusive access to Joe Biden — and for an extra $10,000 absolutely no access to Joe Biden.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Chuck Norris said that if President Obama is re-elected it will lead "to a thousand years of darkness." Then he said if Mitt Romney wins, it will lead to four years of extreme whiteness.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The Republicans are really going after Obama. They asked, "Are you better off now than you were four years ago?" Americans said "No, we're worse off because we never heard of Honey Boo Boo."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Bruce Willis may sue Apple so he can pass down his Apple music collection to his daughter. This could be an important case because if there's one thing teenage girls love, it is their dad's music collection.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Democratic Convention began tonight. What a difference four years makes. Last time the theme was “Hope and change.” This year the theme is “Hope you don’t make a change.”

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The first two nights of the Democratic convention are at the Time Warner Cable Arena and the big speech by President Obama will be at the Bank of America Stadium. That’s good thinking, the two things Americans love most: cable companies and banks.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I’m very excited; we have Ron Paul on the show tonight. Unlike the Republicans, we're actually going to let him speak.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: That had to be rough for Ron Paul. You run for president, you win a bunch of delegates, and not only is he not allowed to speak but he couldn’t even sit down because they gave his chair to Clint Eastwood.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The Democratic National Convention is under way. For three days in Charlotte, N.C., everything the Democrats do is good. And everything Republicans do is evil. It doesn't bother me. I live in Hollywood. It is like that here every day.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Former Democratic nominee John Kerry is going to give a speech about foreign policy. It will be like Clint Eastwood's speech except this time the empty chairs will be in the audience.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I hope they go easy on Clint Eastwood. It wasn't his best performance last week at the Republican convention, but he's given us decades of great films. So Democrats, if you're looking to mock Mitt Romney by dragging an inanimate object out onto the stage, why not just use Mitt Romney?

name: David Letterman
monologue: Outside it's like 82 and cloudy — like Clint Eastwood.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Today was the start of the Democratic National Convention in Charlotte, N.C. They’re going all out to make sure it tops last week’s Republican convention. In fact, I heard at this one they’re going to have Clint Eastwood yell at a couch.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: There are reports that nine of the hotels being used for politicians at the Democratic National Convention have bedbugs. When asked what it’s like to have to deal with thousands of ruthless bloodsuckers, the bedbugs were like, “Eh, it’s OK.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Over the weekend, a chef in Minnesota created the world’s largest bacon cheeseburger, weighing in at over 2,000 pounds. And if you want to hear what it tasted like, you’ll just have to wait until I interview Chris Christie.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I no longer recognize Labor Day as a holiday now that Jerry Lewis is not hosting anymore.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: On Saturday the White House released President Obama's personal recipe for a home-brewed beer. That's how bad the economy is. Not only is our president drinking, he's drinking beer he made in his bathtub.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: A new study has found that men and women see colors differently. And we also see everything else differently.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Women can perceive more than 50 shades of gray, whereas men see a poorly written book.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Here in New York City it's fashion week. One thing to remember here in New York City during fashion week — do not feed the supermodels.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Today, the Democrats added the word "God" to the official party platform. It's in the part that reads, "Did you see Michelle Obama's biceps. Oh, my God!"

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Michelle Obama said the first car Barack picked her up in was so old, you could see ground below them. Today, Ann Romney said the same thing about Mitt's helicopter.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: It is day two of the Democratic convention, and apparently they had a huge lighting problem in the convention hall today. They worked all day on it. They still couldn't get President Obama out of Bill Clinton's shadow.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The stoner comedy duo Harold and Kumar are starring in a new promo for the Democratic convention alongside President Obama, which is pretty impressive. The only other person to go from smoking pot with buddies to the White House is President Obama.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: President Obama's re-election campaign said that this year they'll knock on 150 percent more doors than they did in 2008. Well, of course they will. They have to. There's so many foreclosures it's tough to tell where people live.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: They announced today that they are moving President Obama's speech tomorrow night indoors, from the 74,000-seat stadium to a smaller venue due to the possibility of severe weather. See, apparently the campaign is concerned about this well-known weather phenomenon known as empty seats.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: First lady Michelle Obama is receiving praise for the speech she gave last night at the Democratic National Convention. Everyone was impressed. Even Fox News called it "not the worst."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Actually, President Obama's speech at the DNC has been moved inside to the Time Warner Arena. You can tell it's Time Warner because Obama will give the speech two weeks from Friday, between the hours of 12 and 4.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A farmer in Germany accidentally planted a crop of marijuana after thinking that he was growing sunflowers. The farmer said he was really surprised that the cops actually bought that story.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The Yankees have blown a 10-game lead in the standings, and are now tied for first place. You can tell they're depressed. Today, five of their players tested positive for Häagen-Dazs.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: There's a lot going on tonight. The first NFL game tonight, the Democratic National Convention, a new episode of "Here Comes Honey Boo Boo." Everything that we are as a nation is all rolled up into one tonight.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: The NFL season kicked off in New Jersey. The Dallas Cowboys played the defending champion New York Giants. So ladies, I guess we'll catch up with you on Valentine's Day.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Next year McDonald's is opening two restaurants in India that don't serve meat. They're doing it because cows are sacred in India. Whereas here, they're lunch.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: They'll still have the Happy Meal in India. To be honest, for most people in India, any meal is a happy meal.

name: David Letterman
monologue: It's autumn in New York. The colors are changing — yellow, the browns, the greens, the oranges. And that's just the tap water.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Today Scarlett Johansson, Kerry Washington, and Eva Longoria all spoke at the Democratic convention. This means that Obama has all about clinched the crucial 13-year-old boy vote.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: This morning Tom Brokaw had to be taken to the hospital after accidentally taking an Ambien sleeping pill. And tonight he was taken to the hospital again after accidentally listening to a speech by Joe Biden.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Tom Cruise is being accused of having the Church of Scientology audition women to be his wife. I don't know what the problem is. At least someone in this economy is actually still hiring.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Bill Clinton said that President Obama inherited a deeply damaged economy. And if he's re-elected he'll inherit an even more deeply damaged economy.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: President Obama's speech was moved from the Bank of America stadium to the Time Warner Cable Arena. They had to move out of the big venue into a smaller place. Like a lot of homeowners in the past four years.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: In a related story, Vice President Joe Biden's speech also was moved to a smaller venue — the back room at Denny's, the booth in the corner.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The signature question of this presidential campaign is, "Are you better off than you were four years ago?" As a comedian, I have to say no. I miss Bush and Cheney; they were the golden age. I wish they were here. I am not better off.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Everyone is still talking about Bill Clinton's speech last night in Charlotte. It was a remarkable speech, 45 minutes long and 6,000 words. Like the political version of the guitar solo from "Freebird."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The V.M.A.'s were earlier tonight. V.M.A. stands for video music awards. They were held in downtown Los Angeles at the Staples Center, because what says rock 'n' roll like an office supply superstore?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: One year Kid Rock and Tommy Lee got into a huge fistfight at the V.M.A.'s. I don't remember what the fight was about. I think it was they differed over how the Pythagorean Theorem is the basis for major key scales.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Did you all hear Al Gore speak at the Democratic convention? He said, "Hot dogs, peanuts, cold drinks!"

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Mark Zuckerberg announced he will not sell his 440 million shares of Facebook stock for at least a year. And then, if he does sell, he'll use the money from the sale of the stock to maybe see a movie or take his wife out for a bite to eat.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The economy is so bad, I saw Mitt Romney at the supermarket buying Lobster Helper.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The economy is so bad, Clint Eastwood talked to a chair while going through the cushions looking for spare change.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: I just read that The Situation from "Jersey Shore" is suing a nightclub in Vegas for failing to pay him 60 thousand dollars for two appearances. The case is being handled by his lawyer — The Litigation.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A man in Pennsylvania was arrested for planting marijuana on the property of a church. People could tell something was up because instead of communion wafers, the priest was just handing out Barbeque Pringles.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: After confession, the priest had people do four Hail Marys and five Willie Nelsons.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: TLC is coming out with a new reality show about a group of Amish people who move to New York City. It’s called “Here Comes Honey Jebediah Jebediah.”

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: There was an earthquake last night in Beverly Hills. The second one in a week. We didn't even have time to pick up all the broken pieces of Cher from the last one.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: As people in Beverly Hills were running out of their homes, everyone was yelling the same thing. Oscar and Emmy winners out first.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: There was a big shakeup on "American Idol." There is still a vacant judge's seat. The producers are in a great hurry to fill the empty seat before Clint Eastwood shows up and starts yelling at it.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: This week was the 40th anniversary of "The Price Is Right." The big anniversary special was on Tuesday and Bob says he wasn't asked to be part of it. Apparently, "The Price Is Right" said to its fans, "Come on down — but not you, Bob Barker. You stay right there."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Mitt Romney released another ad that features Hispanic voters speaking in Spanish. The ad ends with him saying, "I'm Mitt Romney, and I have no idea what these people are saying."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Yesterday in Florida, President Obama visited a pizzeria. The owner gave the president a bear hug and lifted him off his feet. Everybody shared a good laugh and then the Secret Service shot the man in the face.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The number one movie at the box office again this weekend was "The Possession," which is a Jewish version of "The Exorcist." The climax of the film is when they force the ghost to retire to Boca Raton.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: It's been reported that Kim Kardashian's mom, Kris Jenner, said that Honey Boo Boo's mom is exploiting her daughter. Moments later Kris Jenner was hospitalized for acute irony poisoning.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Prince Harry is back in the news. Three weeks after those nude photos appeared of him playing strip billiards at a hotel, he was deployed for a four-month tour of duty in Afghanistan. One crazy night and queen grandma ships you right to Kandahar.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Lindsay Lohan tweeted President Obama on the topic of tax cuts. Someone needs to tell her she's Lindsay Lohan and should be focusing on what the president plans to do to cut car insurance deductibles.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: In Chicago today, 26,000 public school teachers went on strike, the first teachers' strike they had in 25 years. Teachers are calling it a last resort. City officials are saying it's unnecessary and wrong, and students are calling it awesome.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Almost every kid in Chicago gets to skip school. It's like there are 400,000 Ferris Buellers loose on the street.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Yesterday, Paul Ryan said that he and Mitt Romney won't reveal their tax plan to the public until after the election. Other politicians couldn't believe it. They were like, "At least do the honorable thing and lie."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A new poll shows that President Obama has expended his lead over Mitt Romney since the Democratic National Convention. Of course, it didn't help Obama as much as that other event — the Republican National Convention.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad is scheduled to address the United Nations on the Jewish holy day of Yom Kippur. That's like the Kardashians giving a speech on Labor Day.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A man in California is accusing Miley Cyrus of punching him in the face at a nightclub over the weekend. Police had a lot of questions for the guy like, "Why would you want the world to know that you got beat up by Miley Cyrus?"

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Jeff Probst, Katie Couric, and Rikki Lake all premiered new talk shows. Oprah Winfrey's show has been off the air a year now. Everyone wants to fill the empty chair left by Oprah except Clint Eastwood. He just wants to yell at the empty chair left by Oprah.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Since Oprah left, everyone's been asking the same question. Whose couch will Tom Cruise jump on when he signs a contract with his next "new wife"?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I'm curious about the show hosted by Jeff Probst. This week's guests are a group of 80-year-old women discussing their sex lives. Isn't that "The View"?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Did you know Judge Judy is the highest paid person on TV right now? She reportedly makes $45 million a year. Some of that's from her TV show. The rest is from her back-alley meth lab.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: In Yemen, a U.S. drone strike has killed al-Qaida's number two leader, the sixth second in command the U.S. has killed. This is one area where Obama can say he definitely is creating jobs.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Over the weekend Mitt Romney made an appearance at a NASCAR race in Virginia. There was an awkward moment when he asked a NASCAR driver why he didn't just hire a chauffeur.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Mitt Romney is not backing down from his statement that America's number one foe is Russia. Then he said America's number one band is Duran Duran and the number one movie is "The Goonies."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: O.J. Simpson is claiming that Khloe Kardashian is his daughter. He makes the claim in his new book called "The Only Thing I'm Ashamed Of."

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Tomorrow Apple is holding a secret media event presumably to unveil the new iPhone 5. They say it has five blades for the closest shave yet.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Snoop Dogg has endorsed Barack Obama's re-election campaign. He also endorsed Samoa Girl Scout cookies.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Snoop made a compelling argument for a person who will probably not remember to vote.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I'm a little surprised. I've always known Snoop to have his mind on his money and his money on his mind, and that's more of a Mitt Romney thing.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Yesterday, Nicki Minaj revealed that in her new song, she only sarcastically endorsed Mitt Romney. Or as Republicans put it, “Wow, you too?”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Actually, members of Mitt Romney’s own party are starting to criticize him for being too vague. When asked if that bothers him, Romney said “Maybe.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A new CNN poll shows that President Obama now has a six-point lead over Mitt Romney. You can tell Romney’s depressed — last night he just sat on his couch and bought the Häagen-Dazs corporation.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A new study found that running for two minutes is just as good for you as working out for 90 minutes. That doesn’t sound like a study — it sounds like something a chubby guy says after being on the treadmill for two minutes.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The biker show, "Sons of Anarchy," kicked off its fifth season tonight. It conflicts with my other favorite show starring a surly, grizzled hombre. Of course I'm referring to "Nancy Grace."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Sons of Anarchy is about a pack of hard-nosed bikers who live outside the law. Think Lance Armstrong, but with less crime and drug dealing.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Over the weekend, Vice President Joe Biden hung out with a biker gang in Ohio. I don't know if that's wise. It's not always a good idea to be associating with shady characters. So next time, think twice, bikers.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The closest I come to trying to cheat death like a tough-guy biker is going outside without sunscreen.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Today marks the Jewish New Year, Rosh Hashanah. It's Hebrew for "I have no writers today."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Mitt Romney is in Los Angeles today for a fundraiser. So that's one more handsome guy in L.A. auditioning for a role he probably won't get.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Mitt Romney is trailing in the polls. After being accused of being too vague, Romney's campaign team says they will start being more specific. When asked when, they said, "Soon-ish."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Arnold Schwarzenegger has written a new book about his affair with his Hispanic housekeeper, and the book is actually called "Total Recall." In response, she's written a book about their affair called "Alien vs. Predator."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: According to the Labor Department, unemployment fell from 8.3 percent to 8.1 percent last month. But that's because 368,000 Americans gave up looking for work. Today, President Obama said that's a step in the right direction, and he is encouraging more Americans to give up looking for work.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Anti-American crowds have been protesting and burning American flags over that anti-Islamic film. And the U.S. is now bracing for more protests next week when the film comes out on Blu-ray.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I'm watching the news, and I see these protesters in countries like Egypt, Afghanistan, Tunisia. They're all burning American flags. Where are they getting all these flags? If you hate us so much, how do you have a large supply of flags on hand?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: All over the world people are chanting, "Death to America." Except in China, where they're chanting, "Not until we get our money back."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Prince was on "The View" this morning. The musician Prince, not the royal prince. You could tell because he was fully clothed.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Today an Italian magazine published 26 pages of Kate Middleton topless. I hope Elton John doesn't write a song about it.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: TMZ says more Kate Middleton and Prince William pictures are coming soon. Apparently the pictures are intimate. Keep in mind that intimate for the royal family is holding hands.

name: David Letterman
monologue: I found out last week that I was named recipient of the Kennedy Center Honors. They give you a lovely statuette. I think it's called the Kenney.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: On Saturday, Mitt Romney took some time off from campaigning to watch his grandson’s soccer game. Though it got awkward when one team pulled their goalie and Romney was like, “Look at that — another job lost under President Obama.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The CEO of IKEA announced that he will retire next year after 34 years with the company. Of course, it was awkward when IKEA just gave him pieces of a gold watch with instructions on how to put it together.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: I read that the Apple executive who designed the iPhone just bought a new $17 million mansion in California. And if there’s any justice at all, he’ll find out the new house isn’t compatible with any of the furniture from his last house.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Today is the one-year anniversary of occupying Wall Street protests. Remember those? They stomped out greed forever.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Mitt Romney was here meeting with the Hispanic Chamber of Commerce. He's looking for a housekeeper for his place in La Jolla.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Mitt Romney was on "Live With Kelly and Michael." At one point Mitt was asked what he wears to bed. He said as little as possible. It's the same philosophy that Mitt has in regard to paying taxes.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Mitt also admitted on the show that his guilty pleasures are peanut butter and jelly sandwiches and chocolate milk. Even his guilty pleasures are boring.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Leaves are falling, temperatures are falling, Romney's poll numbers are dropping. It must be autumn.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The space shuttle is going to be driven through Los Angeles tomorrow. That's exciting. The bad news is that it's going to be driven by Lindsay Lohan.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A lot of people are commenting that Mitt Romney is looking extremely tan lately. In fact, if Romney gets any darker he's not going to vote for himself.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Disney World has announced plans to start serving alcohol. They're even going to introduce a new character — Extremely Buzzed Lightyear.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: New Jersey is banning smiling in driver's license photos. So now instead of telling drivers to say "cheese," the DMV photographer will just say, "You live in New Jersey."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: It's been a rough week for Mitt Romney. Former Minnesota Governor Tim Pawlenty has quit as co-chair of Mitt Romney's presidential campaign. I think the technical term is "jumping ship."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I saw a guy today scraping a Romney bumper sticker off his car. It was Paul Ryan.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Political pundits are taking Mitt Romney to task, saying his latest gaffe was not "presidential." Vice presidential, sure. That's Joe Biden territory.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Newsweek has a new cover story titled "Muslim Rage." Can you believe that? They're still publishing Newsweek.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The moon was a big deal in the 1960s, but so was LSD. For you young people, LSD was used by your parents because they didn't have bath salts.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I'm excited about the Curiosity rover. It took off from Cape Canaveral last November and it landed on Mars a few weeks ago. That's still faster than flying JetBlue.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The rover Curiosity has two separate computer systems. They probably should have called it Bi-Curiosity.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: One thing that Curiosity has already confirmed is that one of the moons of Mars is gradually getting closer to Mars and will probably collide in about 10 million years. And when that happens, well, only Larry King will be around to find out.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: In an interview with Univision, President Obama said if there's one thing he's learned, it's that you can't change Washington from within. So what is he saying — that if we want real change, we should throw him out?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Obama has gone from "Yes we can." to "I'm sorry. No one can."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Mitt Romney's campaign released his 2011 tax return. Democrats still want him to release all his tax returns for the last 10 years. Romney says he can't do it, and he's got a good excuse. He says his dog ate them and then Obama ate the dog.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The economy is so bad, instead of Secret Service protection, the White House is using replacement refs to guard President Obama.

name: Jimmy Fallon
