name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: We got nominated for an Emmy today! And you know what that means — time to iron my tuxedo T-shirt.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: I want to congratulate the History Channel. Their 10-part miniseries “The Bible” was also nominated for an Emmy. It's going to be weird on the red carpet when Moses is like, “Is that Joan Rivers? I haven't seen you since high school.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Congratulations to Charlie Sheen. He just welcomed a granddaughter this week. The nurse was like, "I hope you are ready to do some babysitting." And the baby was like, "Don't worry, I am."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Three million people watched the season premiere of "Here Comes Honey Boo Boo." The cast members say they're delighted. I think that's what they were saying. I don't actually understand what they're saying.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Last night's season premiere had a new cast member. It's me. I play Pierre, an exchange student from France. "Bonjour, Mademoiselle Boo Boo. Would you like some chardonnay with your squirrel?"

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: If you've never seen "Here Comes Honey Boo Boo," it's like "Duck Dynasty" but with fewer ducks.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Here Comes Honey Boo Boo is like "Downton Abbey" but with fewer shoes.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The son of Jerry Sandusky, the Penn State pedophile, has filed papers to have his last name legally changed. You can’t blame him. The weird thing is he's changing it to "Zimmerman."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: According to an English newspaper, a mystery fan has been leaking the results of professional wrestling matches before they even begin. He knows who is going to win and he puts it online. That Edward Snowden has gone too far!

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Is that really a big deal, knowing ahead of time who's going to lose? I mean, Cubs fans have been dealing with that for years.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Researchers in New Mexico say that brain scans of prison inmates can predict whether they will commit another crime. You know another good way to predict? They're already in prison.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The temperature got up to a 100 here in New York City. And now doctors are warning people about something called “heat rage.” It's a real thing, where people to overreact when it gets too hot. It's similar to those other conditions in New York: cold rage, lukewarm rage, and just regular old rage.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A woman in Pennsylvania was just in the news for giving birth to a baby that weighs 13 pounds, 12 ounces and is more than two feet long. You could tell it was big because when it was time to go home, the baby said, “You want me to drive?”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: KFC is coming out with a more upscale restaurant that won't feature any pictures of Colonel Sanders. Because if anything is gonna make KFC more fancy, it's taking out the only person in the restaurant dressed like a gentleman.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A new report says that Audis are more likely to be driven by men who cheat on their wives. While their wives are more likely to wind up with that Audi.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: About 135,000 people have descended on San Diego for Comic-Con. I think Comic-Con might have jumped the shark. I'll tell you why — because I'm going. It's like Sundance Film Festival. I remember when Sundance was cool, all about independent film and serious art. Now it's a place where Paris Hilton goes to party.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I am the Paris Hilton of Comic-Con. If I'm going, it is no longer relevant. Now all I need is a little dog and a sex tape. I'm kidding. I've already got them.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The reason I'm going to Comic-Con is I'm moderating the "Doctor Who" panel. I've been watching "Doctor Who" since the 1960s. But there'll be people at Comic-Con who know a lot more than I do. If I don't know the title of a particular episode, or if I mispronounce the name of an alien planet, I will be shamed like Paula Deen at the BET awards.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: A lot of guys go to Comic-Con dressed as super heroes. Comic-Con is a great place to go if you want to see what all your favorite super heroes would look like if they stopped working out and ate only ice cream.

name: David Letterman
monologue: I'm Dave Letterman, or as the staff likes to call me, "the royal baby."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The royal baby was born today. But don't worry, America, we still have Honey Boo Boo.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Bookies say the odds are 11-2 that the royal baby will be named George, after his great-great-grandfather, King George VI. And the odds are 100-1 he'll be named George after the George Foreman Grill.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Kate Middleton had her baby. The royal baby is eight pounds. Then again, you can't really put a price on a child.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: I was going to go to Comic-Con, but I was stopped by security for possession of a wife and a job.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I’m sure you all heard the news about the royal baby. William and Kate are the proud parents of a baby boy. Can you believe the media coverage? You’d think it was Kim Kardashian and Kanye West having a kid.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: They kept saying on the news, "the royal couple welcomes a baby boy." Well, I hope so. Do people sometimes give a kid the cold shoulder?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I understand there’s a lot of celebrating going on at Buckingham Palace right now. I just hope they’re able to get up for work tomorrow.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Detroit has become the largest city in U.S. history to file for bankruptcy. What happened was Detroit's population dropped something like 70 percent, but the government got bigger. The tax base got smaller, but the government got bigger. Thank God that kind of thing could never happen in Washington.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: It finally happened. Kate Middleton gave birth to a baby boy today. The baby weighed about eight pounds. Americans were like, "How much is that in dollars?"

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Kate Middleton went into labor this morning in London. When the rest of the royal family heard, they were like, "Oh my God. What's labor?"

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: We have former New York Governor Eliot Spitzer on the show tonight. He'll be here only for about five minutes, but we're charging him for the full hour.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Eliot Spitzer is on the show. When he got here, I said, “Do you need someone to escort, er, show you to your dressing room?"

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: It's a great day for our friends in the U.K. There's a new royal baby. The royal family is delighted. Prince Harry popped some champagne and danced naked around the palace. Then he heard about the baby.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The prince said what any proud family member would say: "Back of the line, junior."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: There were very few people in the room for the birth. Prince William, the father, was there. Kate Middleton's mother was there, and Neil Patrick Harris — I believe he was there. He does the Emmys, the Tonys, the royal birth. And you know what, he makes it better. Normally I don't enjoy these things but when Neil does it, it's entertaining.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Britain's new prince is third in line to the throne. And listen to this — my son is third in line for "The Late Show."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The royal baby has been born. The royal baby was officially welcomed with a 62-gun salute. Because if there's one thing babies love, it's the sound of repeated artillery fire.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Experts are predicting that the royal baby could pump $380 million into the British economy. So the question is: How do we get this kid to move to Detroit?

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The royal baby is set to inherit $1 billion. In fact, he's so rich that he's already dating a girl half his age.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: President Obama has issued a statement about the royal baby. He told him to hang on to the birth certificate. Those things come in handy.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The royal baby has left the hospital. He will now go to one of the royal estates, where he will rest comfortably — for the next 80 years.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: This royal baby is third in line for the throne. To which Prince Charles said, “It's a really slow-moving line.”

name: Jay Leno
monologue: William and Kate spent the morning thanking the hospital staff for all their care. And the other patients spent the morning trying to find the hospital staff. “My wife is having a baby too. Hello! Anybody?”

name: Jay Leno
monologue: According to a new study, lying gets easier over time. People get better at lying the more they do it. See, that's why you have to have term limits.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Today we got our first look at the royal baby. Hurray for Kate and William. That little guy has only the tiniest tuft of hair on his head. And the baby's got some hair too.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The crowd outside the hospital was very respectful. You could actually hear the baby say, "Fetch me some milk" and "I will be king, Father."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Mayoral candidate Anthony Wiener had more photographs released from his sexting scandal. New Yorkers were so shocked that Eliot Spitzer fell off his hooker.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: New Yorkers were so shocked that the thing on Trump's head fainted.

name: David Letterman
monologue: The show tonight may run a little longer than usual, and I'll tell you why. We have about 300 Anthony Weiner jokes to get through.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Taylor Swift canceled a radio contest to meet her biggest fan when it turned out her biggest fan was a man nearly twice her age. Nothing's working out for Anthony Weiner these days.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The royal baby finally has a name. It took a few days but they named him Prince George Alexander Louis of Cambridge. The parents said they wanted a name that reflects his country's great history and gets him beaten up at school every day.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Queen Elizabeth met the royal baby yesterday. The baby cried, so Queen Elizabeth explained, "You'll never have to work a day in your life."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Yesterday a pro football player for the Tennessee Titans saved a family from a burning car. Then, because he's an NFL player, he murdered them.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Before we begin the show, I want to ask everyone to turn off their cellphones. It has nothing to do with our program. We just want to protect you from Anthony Weiner. He may try to send you a text.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Anthony Weiner has been caught in yet another sexting scandal. At the beginning of this campaign he said that other texts and photos were likely to come out. Well, they have. Finally, a politician who keeps his promises!

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Anthony Weiner said yesterday that he wants closure. If he wants closure he should start with his zipper.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Obama administration has admitted that under Obamacare, you might not be able to keep your doctor. At first the president guaranteed you'd be able to keep your doctor, and now they're saying you "might" be able to. Today Obama changed his slogan from "Yes we can" to "Perhaps we could try. Can’t promise anything."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The past 24 hours have been so exciting for my wife and I, and we haven't had a chance to respond to everyone's calls and messages, but let me just say, "Yes, William and Kate, we'll definitely set up a play date."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Everybody is still talking about the other baby, the royal baby. In fact, I saw that President Obama released a statement congratulating Prince William and Kate Middleton on the birth of their son. Then he said, “And whatever you do — hang on to that birth certificate.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: There's a new Anthony Weiner scandal. Weiner is running for mayor of New York City. He confirmed yesterday that some new sexually explicit messages have been leaked. He sent them to a woman on Facebook using the code name “Carlos Danger.” Which is still easier to believe than that other name: Mayor Weiner.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: It was revealed that Anthony Weiner sent nude pictures of himself to this woman using a “Carlos Danger” Yahoo email address. His wife was shocked. She said, “You still use Yahoo?”

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The royal baby has a name now: George Alexander Louis. George is not the king yet. So for now, we just address him as "Boy George."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Remember the band, Flock of Seagulls? They had their van stolen. I was like, "They still have a van?"

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: These days, young people watch TV on smartphones and computers. Young people with an actual TV set are harder to find than a picture of Anthony Weiner with his clothes on.

name: David Letterman
monologue: A tourist came up to me today and she says, "I watch your show on and off." And I said, "How do you like it?" And she said, "Off."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: It's been reported that LeBron James will no longer play Olympic basketball for the United States. LeBron said he won't play for any country that has less money than he does.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The NFL wants to test its players for human growth hormone but the players are opposed. Players say there's a time and place for blood tests and that's at their murder trials.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: In Pakistan there's a new TV show about a female superhero. Her super powers include flying, X-ray vision, and going to college.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A man in India is claiming to be the oldest man on earth at 141 years old. Larry King said, "I always liked that kid."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I have been learning more about this NSA spying scandal. What are the odds that the only person they weren't monitoring was Anthony Weiner?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Two years ago when Weiner resigned, he said more embarrassing pictures may come out in the future. Do you know how he knew that? Because he went home after that and started texting them. That's how he knew.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Vatican announced that the late Pope John Paul II will become a saint after they approve a miracle where he cured a woman of severe brain injury, which is pretty impressive. Not as impressive, though, as the miracle of Anthony Weiner still being married, but that's impressive.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: In his speech earlier this week in Latin America, the Pope told the people to give up the false idols of success and money. That’s the same thing NBC told me.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: President Obama gave a big speech yesterday on the economy. It was actually longer than his last State of the Union address — though it should be noted that he opened with 20 minutes of Anthony Weiner jokes.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Taco Bell announced that it will discontinue its line of kids' meals because of low sales. You know your food's bad when even little kids say, “I'm not putting that in my mouth.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A new study found that kids have better relationships with their parents if they're friends with them on Facebook. That's good because if you're a kid who's friends with your parents on Facebook, chances are you're not really friends with anyone else.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Rocky is back. Again. Yeah, 67-year-old Sylvester Stallone is getting ready to star in a seventh “Rocky” movie. You can tell he’s getting up there because instead of running up those famous stairs, now Rocky just takes the elevator.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Another tough day for New York mayoral candidate Anthony Weiner. Or as we know him now, "Carlos Danger." I'm no prude, but I think texting obscene pictures crosses the line. Even Geraldo Rivera was like, "Dude, put some clothes on."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I'm conflicted about Anthony Weiner. On one hand, after the pain he caused his family I think he should drop out of the race. On the other hand, his staying makes my job even easier.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: At least one case of bubonic plague has been confirmed here in L.A. It was a squirrel. I hope the plague doesn't spread. If it wipes out squirrels across the country, what's Honey Boo Boo going to have for dinner?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: What would happen if bubonic plague came to L.A.? People could be turning ungodly shades of purple. Suffering in the streets. An utter disregard for human life. And then the plague would hit.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Neural scientists at M.I.T. say they can plant false memories in your brain. No, that is not new. Politicians have been doing that for years. They're called campaign promises.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: In a speech about the economy, President Obama said we've all been distracted by phony scandals. It’s time we started getting distracted by the phony recovery.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The head of the TSA said beginning later this year people can pay an $85 fee that will allow them to go through the airport line very quickly with minimal checking. Or as terrorists call that, money well spent.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Lincoln Memorial was vandalized last night. Somebody snuck in the Lincoln Memorial and threw green paint all over Lincoln. How is that even possible? I mean, 148 years later this guy still can't get any security? Come on.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Poor Anthony Wiener. His campaign has hit a snag. The first survey since his recent scandal found he is now second place in the race for New York City mayor. He said it's a minor setback, while the guy in third said, "Are you kidding me? What do I gotta do?"

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Weiner is in second place. He is no longer in the lead. And it gets worse when you hear the guy in first place is Carlos Danger.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: President Obama's got a big retreat coming up. He invited all his Cabinet members to Camp David. Unfortunately, Joe Biden couldn't make the retreat because he's in Asia. That's because Obama told him the retreat was in Asia.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: There is a big movie opening today — "Wolverine." Hugh Jackman is a guy with sharp nails who'll tear apart any man who crosses his path. I'm not sure what he does in the movie.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I'm a big fan of Wolverine, and the other X-Men too. I can name them all. Wolverine, Professor Xavier, Cyclops, Storm, Rogue, Sugar Bear, Pumpkin, Chickadee, Mama June, and Honey Boo Boo.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: In the comics, Wolverine is a Canadian citizen who worked for the Canadian government. I love the thought of a Canadian superhero. They should have called him Captain Hockey. Or The Lone Bieber.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: In the new movie, Wolverine goes to Japan. Over in Japan, they don't call him Wolverine, of course. They call him "Big Fuzzy-Head Man.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: In Brazil, 3 million people attended the Pope's mass. The Pope attributed the huge turnout to his opening act, the Red Hot Chili Peppers. He tours with them wherever he goes.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Pope Francis today said he will not judge priests who are gay. In response, gay priests said they will not judge Pope Francis for wearing that robe with those shoes.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The inventor of the world's first artificial test-tube hamburger said that "It looks, feels, and hopefully tastes like meat." He was immediately sued by Arby's for stealing their slogan.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: In Oregon a guy tried to rob a gun store with a baseball bat. They're calling it the most ineffective use of a bat since the Miami Marlins.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Things are not looking good for former New England Patriot Aaron Hernandez. It looks like he may spend the rest of his life in jail. On the plus side, Hernandez says he's looking forward to playing on the prison football team under coach Whitey Bulger.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Speaking of prison, OJ Simpson is supposedly up to around 300 pounds. In fact, OJ is now the leading cause of prison overcrowding.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: OJ is so fat, he’s asking for the death penalty just so he can get the last meal.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Anthony Weiner's campaign manager quit. He says he's applying for a much less stressful job that has a better chance of success. He is trying to get Paula Deen elected president of BET.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I think we look back at times past with fondness because we were younger. Life had not yet begun pecking away at our innocence like buzzards on fresh road kill.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: A lot of people in their 30s get nostalgic for their teen years. Then they get jobs in TV, become bitter and jaded and prematurely old. Then they turn their nostalgia into great television.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: In the 1990s we had "That '70s Show," set in the 1970s. The 1970s had "Happy Days" set in the 1950s. And the 1950s had shows set in the 1930s. We had "Here Comes Hitler Boo Boo," "Live with Regis and Herbert Hoover," and "Real Housewives of the Great Depression."

name: David Letterman
monologue: Pope Francis went to Rio in South America and announced that he would not judge anyone who is gay. That's what Pope Francis said. That must have been some trip to Rio.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: It’s been a rough week for Anthony Weiner. His campaign manager in the race for mayor just quit because of Weiner’s newest scandal. And it's tough finding a replacement because every time he emails someone, they're like, “I'm not opening that.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: This new sexting scandal was too much, so his campaign manager called it quits. Weiner was like, “What kind of person quits because of something like that?” Then voters said, “Ideally? You.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: I read that 25 percent of toddlers in America know how to use an iPad — while 100 percent of toddlers in China know how to make one.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: There's talk that HBO is actually running out of story ideas for “Game of Thrones” because the author hasn't finished the final two books in the series. That's when you know books are hurting — when even the guy writing them is like, “Ahh, I'll just watch the TV show.”

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Pope Francis said something surprising today. Pope Francis says he's going to start fighting in MMA events.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Actually the Pope said he has no problem with priests who are gay. He said if someone is gay and he searches for the Lord and has good will, who am I to judge? It's the same reason he turned down the vacant judge job on "Project Runway."

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Pope Francis still does not support the idea of female priests. He said women cannot be priests because Jesus chose male apostles. And also because letting women in there would ruin all the fun. I mean, let's be honest.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Neil Patrick Harris is here tonight. He hosted the Tonys this year. He's hosting the Emmys in September. Who knows? Maybe he'll finish this show for me tonight.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Oprah Winfrey's TV channel OWN has finally turned a profit. Thank God we no longer have to worry about how Oprah is going to make ends meet.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A high school in Arkansas is letting teachers carry concealed weapons. So now when students want to ask a question, they raise both hands.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Today after years of waiting, peace talks resumed between the Israelis and Palestinians. No, wait. I'm sorry. This cue card is from 1979. And 1984. And 1988.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Happy birthday to Arnold Schwarzenegger. He's 66 years old today. It was an odd celebration. Arnold didn't really get excited until after the party when the maids came to clean up.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Illegal border crossings in California are way down this month, especially in San Diego. It's because people are scared they might get groped by the mayor if they come across.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Seven women have come forward to say they’ve been sexually harassed by San Diego Mayor Bob Filner. The mayor has agreed to intensive rehab therapy. They say it’s a 12-step program. Here’s a simple 12-step program: Just stay 12 steps away from all women.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: NFL training camps opened last week. Players said it's nice to be under the lights again — besides the one in the interrogation rooms.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Happy birthday today to Arnold Schwarzenegger, who is 66. Arnold celebrated quietly at home with his friends and families.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Justin Bieber's tour bus was stopped by Canadian border patrol agents. And they found marijuana. The agents said Bieber was a disgrace to Canada and should never come back. Then they found the marijuana.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: A woman in Germany gave birth to a 13 1/2 pound baby. That baby was so fat his first word was "strudel."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The German baby is so fat that when he wears blue, people think he is the sky.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Arnold Schwarzenegger is 66 years old today. That's according to records kept by Jane Goodall.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Anthony Weiner has fallen to fourth place in the Democratic race for New York City mayor. Even worse, third place is a write-in candidate — “Anyone else but Weiner.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Yesterday on Fox News, Donald Trump said there is something “mentally wrong” with Anthony Weiner. He said, “That guy is dangerous, unstable, and disgusting. So look for him next season on 'Celebrity Apprentice.'”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A new study says it's harder to sleep when there's a full moon. I sleep just fine when there's a full moon. When I wake up, my clothes are torn and about seven people are dead, but other than that I sleep fantastic.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Russian President Vladimir Putin was on vacation last week, and apparently he caught a giant 46-pound fish. Putin called it a crowning achievement, while the manager of the aquarium said, “What am I supposed to do? He's president.”

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: One of the women with whom Anthony Weiner had an online relationship, a 23-year-old vixen named Sidney Leathers, is so embarrassed that she stripped down to a bikini photo for the New York Post. The photo was exclusive — because nobody else showed up to photograph her.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I feel like this Sidney Leathers is every woman rolled into one large, disturbing package of tattoos.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Anthony Weiner's wife is Huma, and you know, when you get married you swear to love each other for better or worse, and this is worse. In fact, it couldn't be much worse.

name: David Letterman
monologue: The ban on giant sugary sodas has been overturned. You can now go to 7-eleven and get yourself a soda cup. There's one so big that Simon and Garfunkel had a reunion concert in it.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new poll came out and says that most Democrats think Anthony Weiner has basically lost his mind. Weiner said, "The important thing is I haven't lost my phone."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A Russian official announced that gay athletes attending the 2014 Olympics there will be arrested. This is good news for the world's three straight male figure skaters. Just show up, get a medal, you're done. No competition.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Nevada's parole board said O.J. Simpson could be granted early parole. O.J. said he's looking forward to getting out and showing today's NFL players how to REALLY murder someone.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Al-Qaida announced that they will try to free the inmates at Guantanamo Bay. Yeah, because nothing helps you pull off a prison break like announcing it ahead of time.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Ladies and gentlemen, Lindsay Lohan is out of rehab! TMZ's reporting that she'll spend a few days with a sober coach. Might I suggest she also see a stay-out-of-court coach, a don't-steal coach, a career coach — and most of all, a driving coach, OK?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Sunday, on his way home from Brazil, Pope Francis said it was not his job to judge gays. He said that's what the Tony Awards are for.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Discovery Channel had a fascinating show about ants. Did you know an ant can lift 20 times its own weight? It used to be only five times its own weight, but then Alex Rodriguez told them about a clinic in Florida.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Rumor is that Alex Rodriguez may soon be facing a serious penalty for steroid use — either a lifetime ban from the sport or a trade to the Houston Astros.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The Anthony Weiner campaign's communications director is in trouble for calling a former intern an inappropriate name. But Weiner said he'd take care of it. He promised to give them both a good texting to.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: I don't know if I believe this or not, but there's this new study that says a wedding is actually the best place to meet someone. Then Anthony Weiner said, "It's true. At my wedding I got like five or six phone numbers."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Time Warner announced that their CEO will resign at the end of the year. They say they would've done it sooner, but that was the earliest they could get a technician to come out and install a replacement.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The producers of the next “Star Wars” movie say they will avoid using CGI as much as possible so the film looks more realistic. That's good because whenever I watch aliens and robots fighting with lasers, my first reaction is, “Hmmmm, seems pretty fake.”

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: This is night three of beard week. It is a great tradition that dates back to the last time I didn't feel like shaving.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I hate shaving. Do you realize when you shave you put a razor blade on your face and everything is scraped off?

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: What maniac started the idea of shaving? Who decided we should leave the eyebrows alone?

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Anthony Weiner has vowed to continue to fight. He said he is staying in the race because he cares deeply about the people of New York — except for the one he is married to.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Major League Baseball said that on Friday it will announce which players they're penalizing for steroid use. So far the rumor is . . . all of them.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: An NFL player is in big trouble for making a comment at a country music concert that's offensive to black people. His comment was, "I enjoy country music."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: In a recent interview, Katy Perry revealed that she would like to become a serious actress. She then did a monologue from "Macbeth" in a bra made of ice cream.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Facebook has a new feature that allows you to see what you were posting a year ago. You just log on to Facebook and click on the "I'm wasting my life" button.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: More problems for America's creepiest mayor, San Diego's Bob Filner. An eighth woman has now come forward to say that she was sexually harassed by him. She said she would've come forward sooner but the line was too long.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Mayor Filner now wants the city of San Diego to pay for his sexual harassment lawsuit. He says it's only fair because he harassed women only on government time, never his own time.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: In what has to be the most outrageous defense ever — this is real — Filner's lawyer said if there's any liability, it's the city liable for failing to give the mayor sexual harassment training. Oh, come on now. Just shut up!

name: Jay Leno
monologue: It is not looking good for Alex Rodriguez. There's a good chance he could be banned from baseball for life. How good? He got 2-to-1 odds from Pete Rose.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The X Games start today in L.A. Everyone's excited about the X Games, except Larry King. He thought it was a convention for his previous wives.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: President Obama is going to appear on "The Tonight Show" with Jay Leno. That's going to be awesome. The most powerful man in the country is going to interview President Obama.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: In a new interview, Republican Senator John McCain implied that he might vote for Hillary Clinton in 2016. McCain's getting old. He also said he'd consider voting for oatmeal.

name: David Letterman
monologue: The big "Smurfs" movie sequel is out. It's cute little elves that live together in harmony. And the Pope said, "Who am I to judge them?"

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Edward Snowden, the guy who leaked all that information about the NSA, finally got to leave the Moscow airport this morning after being held there for five weeks. When asked what he wanted to eat, he said, “Anything but Cinnabon.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Congress has a month-long vacation coming up, but House Republicans are being pressured to use their time off to reach out to women, young people, and minorities. So they all got together and decided to go to a Selena Gomez concert.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: It's rumored that AMC’s show “The Walking Dead” is adding a zombie baby to the cast for next season. That’s right, a drooling, hungry creature that can’t talk or listen to reason — most people just call that “a baby.”

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Hawaii has a new service that they hope will reduce the homeless population. What they do is buy the homeless people a one-way ticket back home. I don't know how you can go home if you're homeless.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: How can you even tell who is homeless in Hawaii? No one wears shoes.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: If you're homeless, the state will pay for your plane ticket and transportation to the airport. The hard part is trying to get the shopping cart in the overhead compartment.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: If homeless people don't want to fly, they will pay for them to go home on a cruise. That is just what the cruise industry needs — "Now with homeless people."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Happy birthday to President Obama! He will be 52 years old on Sunday. I bet he can't wait for Michelle to wheel out that tofu cake with the broccoli icing.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: If you'd like to get the president a gift, you can't go wrong with Edward Snowden. He would love that.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: There's a big fight in the Republican Party between Chris Christie and Rand Paul. In an effort to end the spat, Paul offered to have a beer with Christie. But Christie refused. Christie said, "It's going to take a lot more than a beer to win me over. You're going to need wings, stuffed potato skins, tater tots, ribs, onion rings — I need the whole deal.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The White House approved an exemption in Obamacare coverage for Congress and members of their staff. Members complained that the Affordable Care Act will cost them thousands extra a year in premiums. Wait a minute. It's their bill. If it's too expensive, why did they name it the Affordable Care Act?

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: In an interview with Univision, Anthony Weiner said he created the online name, Carlos Danger, as a joke. Weiner was like "Come on, what's funnier than the name Carlos Danger?" They we're like, "uh, Anthony Weiner?"

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The NFL is about to get its first full-time female referee. Good for them. It will be a little different though. When a player asks her what he did wrong, she'll say "Oh, you know what you did."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Amazon said it's going to hire at least 5,000 new employees. They were originally going to hire only 4,000, but realized if they added a few more, they'll get free shipping.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: This is the 26th year of shark week. It started as a gimmick in the late 1980s. It has grown into a cultural phenomenon that scares the crap out of everyone. It's like David Hasselhoff.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Shark week is so awesome. I'm surprised other networks don't also have shark-themed programing. Shows like "Sharks and Recreation," "How I Ate Your Mother," and "The Tonight Show With Jaws Leno."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: A couple of years ago Ryan Seacrest was actually bitten by a shark. That's true. Can you imagine being in the water with a ferocious man-eater like that? And the shark's pretty scary too.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Major League Baseball announced today that Alex Rodriguez has been suspended for 211 games. So if you're familiar with baseball's schedule, it means he'll be out for about a month. I think there are 10,000 games in a season.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: This weekend President Obama celebrated his 52nd birthday. For his birthday, Michelle Obama jumped out of a cake and told him he's not allowed to have any.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Photos of the royal baby's birth certificate have surfaced. Kate's occupation on the document is listed as "princess." It's always inspiring to me when a new mother decides to remain in the workplace.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: One of the latest trends is an ATM machine where transactions are conducted by a human teller. The cutting-edge device is called a bank.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Baseball suspended 13 players for alleged use of performance-enhancing drugs, most notably baseball's highest paid player, Alex Rodriguez of the Yankees. A-Rod is suspended for 211 games. That is an odd number, but .211 is what they calculated his batting average would have been without the drug.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: A-Rod held a press conference earlier in Chicago. He dodged almost every question. But when asked directly, "Did you use performance-enhancing drugs?" he said, "Me no steroids" and then knocked White Sox Stadium down with his bare hands.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I don't believe A-Rod used performance-enhancing drugs, but I also don't believe in Canadians. Really, there are millions of people living in another country right above us? I don't think so.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Kobe Bryant was in China this weekend. The NBA is very popular in China, which makes sense because that's where all the shoes come from.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: This is the final season of AMC's "Breaking Bad," and I know how it ends. It turns out that Walter White stops cooking meth and opens his own sports medicine lab with Alex Rodriguez.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Major League Baseball has suspended Alex Rodriguez for 211 games, but A-Rod is still fighting. He's vowing to come back 10 times bigger and 10 times stronger. I don't know if that's a good sign or not.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: It's not just A-Rod. Baseball gave 12 players 50-game suspensions. The rules are clear. If you're going to do drugs and still expect to play, you'd better be a musician. That's the only way you can do drugs and still play.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The horrible news for Cubs fans is that not one of their players got suspended today. That means they're stuck with the same guys for the rest of the year.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Alex Rodriguez has been suspended from baseball for 211 games, but he said he’ll appeal the decision and keep playing. Yeah, even Anthony Weiner was like, “Man, some people just don’t know when to quit.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A-Rod was suspended for buying performance-enhancing drugs from an anti-aging clinic in Florida. You know, because if there’s one place where people really know how to look young, it’s Florida.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: President Obama celebrated his 52nd birthday yesterday. You can tell he’s getting older because he no longer supports President Obama.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The Boston Globe newspaper has been sold for $70 million, even though 20 years ago it went for $1.1 billion. I couldn’t believe that story when I saw it for free on the Internet.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The Smurfs 2 is a great movie. The Smurfs are tiny little creatures that everybody loves. They're like Justin Bieber — minus the part about everybody loving him.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I can't decide on a favorite Smurf. I love Papa Smurf, of course. And the one who's always yelling at everyone with those long-winded stories. What's his name? Oh yeah, Regis Smurf.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Then there's Tito Smurf, Jermaine Smurf, and Kardashian Smurf.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Papa Smurf is their leader, but he wasn't an elected leader. He inherited the position after the death of his father, Kim Jong Smurf.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Alex Rodriguez returned to baseball last night. After appealing his drug suspension, Alex thanked his family, friends, and fans for their support. Then he thanked all the horses and cattle for their testosterone.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Jeff Bezos, the founder of Amazon, has purchased The Washington Post for $250 million. He said that last night, like most Amazon customers, he was drunk and buying crap on the Internet he didn't need.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: At an airport in Connecticut a man was arrested after saying he had a bomb. He was released as soon as he showed police his DVD of "The Lone Ranger."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Welcome to a very special edition of "The Tonight Show." The White House announced that in the coming days, President Obama will be reaching out to Americans who have lost their jobs. In fact, that’s why he’s here with me tonight. He’s talking to me personally.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: As our studio audience knows, the security today was incredible. In fact, first lady Michelle Obama already had the Secret Service sweep the president’s dressing room for chips, pizza, ice cream — any kind of snack, donut, any kind of sweets.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Happy birthday to President Obama! He turned 52 over the weekend. You can see he is getting a little grayer. In fact, they are starting to call him "The Silver Fox." That’s because most of the silver in his hair was caused by Fox.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: All our best to former President George W. Bush, who is recovering from successful heart surgery today. All day the media have been sending get-well wishes to President Bush. Fox News sent flowers. MSNBC sent a steak and cheese fries.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Jeff Bezos, the CEO of Amazon.com, just bought The Washington Post for $250 million. He just walked into the Post's headquarters and said, “Add to cart.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Since Bezos bought the Post before 11 a.m., he got same-day delivery.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Alex Rodriguez was suspended from baseball for using performance-enhancing drugs, but then he appealed, so technically he can still play. Last night he played his first game since the suspension and hit a bloop single. And then he said, "Imagine how far that would have gone if I was still on steroids!”

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: It is Jamaican Independence Day. Today in Jamaica, everyone spent the entire day smoking, drinking, and having a great time — and then they remembered it was Jamaican Independence Day.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: People think everyone in Jamaica smokes marijuana. That is just not true. Some of them eat it.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Jamaica isn't far away from Florida. If you go to Jamaica, on a quiet night you can hear old people in Boca Raton laughing at CBS sitcoms.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I wanted to go to Jamaica because "Dr. No" — the first James Bond movie — was filmed there with Ursula Andress. In that movie, they show all the beach scenes in Jamaica and all the jungle scenes in Sean Connery's chest hair.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: President Obama has called off a summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin because of diplomatic differences. Also, Obama didn't like Putin's demand that the summit be held shirtless and on horseback.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Michelle Obama's new initiative is to fight obesity through hip-hop. She hopes it goes better than the previous initiative — fighting marijuana use through reggae.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Brigham Young University has been named the top sober school in America for the 16th year in a row. The students celebrated by having the worst party ever.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The NFL announced that referees are going to crack down this year on excessive celebrations. NFL players are being told not to show off too much after a touchdown, a sack, or a murder.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: The University of Iowa has been named the No. 1 party school in America for 2013. So congratulations and shame on them.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: One thing nice about Iowa: It is flat. So when you pass out you won't fall off any cliffs or anything.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: An Iowa spokesman said the percentage of kids drinking five or more drinks in a day dropped from 73 percent in 2009 to only 58 percent last year. I like that they say "only 58 percent." That is when you know you have a party school on your hands.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I don't know why the Iowa school would deny something like that. If I was in charge, not only would I not deny it, I would mention it in all the advertising.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: U.S. embassies are closed all around the Middle East this week due to a terrorist threat. What happened was the U.S. intercepted a conference call of 20 al-Qaida operatives. Twenty on one conference call! Who is their carrier? I go under a bridge and my cellphone drops the call, but they can get 20 people in one call from a cave?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: We had President Obama on the show last night. It was a huge honor, but all the security made it difficult getting into the building. Security was checking IDs, the Secret Service was searching cars, Donald Trump was out front checking birth certificates — it was crazy.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Republican National Committee now says if NBC and CNN don't pull plans for a Hillary Clinton miniseries and movie, they won't hold any Republican debates on those networks. That works for me! Now if we could just get the Democrats to pull their debates, we wouldn’t have to watch any of that crap.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: This story just gets crazier: Two more women have come forward to accuse San Diego Mayor Bob Filner of sexual misconduct. That brings the total to 13 — or as Filner calls it, a groper's dozen.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: During a fundraiser last night, Mitt Romney told Republicans that they need to pick a candidate for 2016 who can actually win. And Republicans said, "Yeah, I wish you told us that last year. But hey, thanks a lot."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Last week, a woman in Nevada gave birth to a healthy baby boy in the bathroom of a Subway restaurant. Afterwards, the manager said, "Uh, you still have to buy something. Restrooms are for customers only."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A study found that if given a choice, most Americans would not want to live to the age of 120. People don't want to live to 120 except for one group — people who are at 119.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I'm not one of those ex-smokers who says, "I'll never smoke again." I would start smoking again in a heartbeat. The only thing stopping me is the painful early death.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I fancy smoking a pipe. Actually, I would like to just fill my pipe and then put on a robe and go around solving crimes.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The big trend these days is electronic cigarettes. They are not as bad for you. I suppose they're safer than regular cigarettes, but a lot of things are safer than cigarettes. That's like saying your movie made more money than "The Lone Ranger" or like saying you fathered fewer children than Arnold Schwarzenegger.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The Secret Service is asking people on Twitter to report any suspicious tweets. So now if your boss catches you on Twitter, just tell him you're protecting the country.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A man in Colorado wants marijuana to be classified as a vegetable. I just have to say that that's an ingenious way to get Americans to stop smoking pot.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A scientist has figured out a way to turn coffee grounds into alcohol. He is not so much a scientist as he is an alcoholic.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: The third-largest lottery drawing in the U.S. took place last night, a Powerball jackpot worth $448 million. The jackpot will be split between three winners. I'm happy for whoever they are, as long as their names are not Kim, Kourtney, Khloe, or Kris.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: One of the winners is a 45-year-old man from Ham Lake, Minnesota, which sounds delicious.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: After taxes and jet skis, I think the winnings work out to $148.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I guess you all heard about this terrorist threat the president warned us about. One of the reasons al-Qaida is upset with the United States is because we are giving aid to Yemen. We didn’t have a choice. When life hands you Yemen, you give them Yemen aid.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The Mars rover Curiosity is celebrating its first anniversary on Mars. So far, in the year it’s been up there it’s sent back 70,000 photos. I know that sounds like a lot, but it’s still less than Anthony Weiner sent out.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Researchers at the University of Chicago say that dolphins, not elephants, have the longest memories in the animal kingdom. They confirmed this when a dolphin was upset that an elephant it had met 20 years ago didn’t even recognize him.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Before they went on vacation, Congress voted to exempt themselves from Obamacare. They gave themselves a special exemption because they thought it was too expensive. So the people who voted for Obamacare for us voted to exempt themselves from it. You know how doctors take the Hippocratic Oath. Congress apparently takes the "Hypocritic Oath."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The New York City Department of Education says that only 26 percent of the city's students passed the English portion on a recent standardized test. But on the bright side, they're too bad at math to realize how bad that is.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: LeBron James of the Miami Heat had to report for jury duty today. Of course there will be 11 other jurors to help decide the case, but you know he'll wind up doing it all by himself.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: After The Washington Post and The Boston Globe were both sold this week, the owner of The New York Times came out and said that his paper is not for sale. Oh yeah? Then how come I just bought one at a newsstand?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Fifty years ago today was "the great train robbery." Robbers got away with $63 million in cash from a postal train in Britain. My father worked for the post office at that time. He was supposed to be working on the night that it was robbed, but he had the flu. He called in sick. Coincidence?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: All I know is right after the great train robbery, we ate well around my house. Yes, that is the night we got a brand new potato.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The train was going from Glasgow to London. So the Scottish banks lost millions. Scottish people were spewing venom and then the robbery happened and it got worse.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I like heist movies. "Oceans 11" was a good one. Then there was "Oceans 12" where they robbed the people who went to see the movie.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The NFL says they are going to crack down on excessive celebrations this season. The only time they will allow a celebration is when an NFL player is found “not guilty.”

name: Jay Leno
monologue: LeBron James reported to jury duty in Akron, Ohio. He didn't get picked, but when he walked into the courtroom the jury was made up of Cavalier fans who sentenced him to death.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Yesterday, President Obama met with the Greek prime minister to discuss reforming Greece's economy. President Obama talked with the prime minister of Greece about the economy. Actually, it’s "the blind leading the blind."

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Anthony Weiner has released a 19-page booklet on how to improve life in New York City. Oh, please. If Weiner wants to improve life in New York City, he should move to New Jersey.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The new iPhone is coming soon. The new iPhone is going to have a new feature that actually keeps track of your every movement. Then President Obama was like, “Right. NEW feature.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Yesterday, Obama met with the prime minister of Greece at the White House. When he heard the leader of Greece was there, Biden said, “John Travolta's here?"

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Football season is right around the corner! Yep, the New England Patriots played their first exhibition game tonight, and Tim Tebow said he wasn't sure if he would play, but Coach Belichick told him to be ready. Then he said, “To not play.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The NFL announced that it's going to start cracking down on players who celebrate too much after scoring a touchdown. Then the Jets were like, "Phew, good thing we don't have to worry about THAT!"

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: A movie opens today. It is called "Elysium." It stars Matt Damon. The movie takes place in the future where a lot of things are very different, but strangely Jay Leno is still hosting "The Tonight Show."

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: In the movie, earth has been overrun with crime, disease, and pollution. Basically, the entire world is Los Angeles.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Controversial Yankees slugger Alex Rodriguez hit his first home run of the year and the season premiere of "Breaking Bad" aired. It was a big day for drug dealers.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Oprah was shopping in Switzerland and a Swiss clerk refused to show her a $38,000 purse. To prove her point, Oprah bought Switzerland.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: At the Missouri State Fair, a rodeo clown put on a President Obama mask and tried to get a bull to chase him. Yeah. But it backfired because the bull sat down and said, "Let's be fair and see what he does with his second term."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Star Wars creator George Lucas and his wife just welcomed their first child. He won't tell the child he is the father until episode five.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: It's back-to-school season. Going back to school, especially to a new school, can be scary, but I do have some advice, and I think it's good advice for kids. Be yourself. And if that doesn't work, be someone cooler.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: In Tennessee, a boy seven months old was at the center of a legal battle because his parents couldn't agree on his last name. They went to court and the magistrate refused to validate the kid's FIRST name. The parents wanted to name him Messiah. The magistrate forced them to change it to Martin. If the first name is Messiah, you'll never find those little personalized license plates for your bike.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I think we should bring that magistrate to Hollywood and put her in charge of celebrity baby names because they're not even giving their kids names anymore. They're giving them nouns. You go to any playground in L.A., yell the word "river," and 10 kids will come running.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: North Korea has announced that it's developing its own smartphone. Unfortunately, the phones are so smart, they've already escaped from North Korea.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Scientists have found a new link between high blood sugar and dementia. Which explains Cinnabon's new slogan, "The last bite you'll remember."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: There's a new cable channel of entirely dog-based programing called Dog TV. In a related story, there's also an entirely cat-based channel called YouTube.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A hotel in New York now offers a plastic surgery recovery package. Basically it's a place for people to relax after they've seen Bruce Jenner up close.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The mayor of San Diego has been accused of sexually harassing 14 women. Now a Hooters in San Diego has put up a sign saying they won't serve Mayor Bob Filner because he disrespects women. A spokesperson for Hooters said we don't want him as a customer, but would love him as a manager.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new study came out that found the very worst drivers drive a Prius. Apparently, it's very difficult to drive while patting yourself on the back.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The makers of drones want the media to stop calling their unmanned aircrafts 'drones.' They don't like the name drones. The manufacturers said, we prefer the term 'surprise visitor.'

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: According to a new study, most men would like women to occasionally pick up the check. The study also found most women would occasionally like to be paid as much as men for doing the same job.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Justin Bieber did something nice yesterday and he wants to make sure you know about it. He was driving through L.A. and happened upon a woman who asked him for money. So he stopped and handed her money and posted a picture of himself on Instagram. Always give back: a good message. Maybe we can give him back to Canada.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: And in North Korea, they developed the first-ever smartphone, just like an iPhone. But if you ask Siri any questions, she reports you to the police.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: It is widely believed these phones were secretly built in China and shipped to North Korea. It's hard to believe they built a smartphone, because wi-fi and cellphone data plans are illegal there. You can't even have friends and family in North Korea.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Some park rangers in California found a plot on which someone grew 500,000 pounds of marijuana. They assume this pot was grown by humans, but I wouldn't rule out bears. Think about it: They sleep three months a year, all you ever see them doing is rummaging through the trash trying to find food, and their leader's name is Smokey.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Mayor Filner of San Diego has had 14 women come forward alleging that he sexually harassed them. In San Diego, Hooters restaurants are refusing to serve Filner because they say he's disrespectful to women in his office. The CEO said there's a time and a place to be disrespect to women and that's at a Hooters.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: According to a new report, Tulsa, Oklahoma, has the lowest rent in the country. Yeah, nice try Tulsa, but we're still not moving there.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The NFL is considering hiring a mother of three to be a referee. They wanted someone who's used to giving time-outs.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: We had quite a night last night. Oprah Winfrey was here. Are you familiar with her work?

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Oprah swooped down from heaven last night, and there was a rainbow over the theater. Have you ever seen a rainbow at night?

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: We have music tonight from Big Sean. You know, before you do rap, they make you decide if you're big or little.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Why is it that rappers are always big or little? Any of them ever come in medium?

name: David Letterman
monologue: Recently, in one of the New York City subway cars, they found a dead shark. Other passengers just thought he was sleeping so they didn't say anything. The Transit authority suspects foul play.

name: David Letterman
monologue: A couple of days ago they found a great white shark dead on a subway car in New York, and today he's chowder at Red Lobster. Yep, they found him on surveillance tape going down the stairs and through the turnstile. He seemed perfectly healthy.

name: David Letterman
monologue: When Batman fans heard Ben Affleck is going to be the new Batman, they went crazy and petitioned the White House to get rid of Ben Affleck, do something! Nothing, however, about getting rid of the goon running the show in Syria. But Ben Affleck has got to go!

name: Jay Leno
monologue: But it's not all bad news for the former San Diego mayor. Today Bob Filner was offered a new job as a TSA agent at the airport. So, you fly often, do you?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: So New York City comptroller candidate Eliot Spitzer says if he wins, he will work for only $1 a year. Which is pretty smart, because at that rate, he won't be able to afford another $5,000 an hour hooker until the year 7013.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The NFL is now cracking down on what they call excessive celebration, like when a player is found not guilty and does that little dance in the courtroom. OK, that's 15 yards now.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Pepsi has introduced a new snack food called Pepsi-flavored Cheetos. I mean, who is this for? On-the-go stoners who don't have time to eat both?

name: Jay Leno
monologue: Pepsi and Cheetos? Really? Are we that lazy now we have to combine the snack and the drink together? Is the Pepsi can too heavy? Oh, it's too heavy, getting carpal tunnel bringing it up here.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Miley Cyrus has been granted asylum in Russia. That's what I heard.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: The state attorney general of New York is suing Donald Trump for $40 million, claiming that Donald Trump University is not a real university. The state claims it's not a real college because students get very little education and were unable to find jobs after they graduated. Sounds like a real college to me.

name: Jay Leno
monologue: I guess the attorney general got suspicious it wasn't a real college when Donald took the senior class on a field trip to try and find President Obama's birth certificate.

name: Jay Leno
