monologue: A man in Dublin punched a hole in a $10 million painting by Claude Monet. And today he was sentenced to five years in prison. For punching a painting? There are going to be more fists going where they shouldn't.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Why would an Irish dude walk into a museum and punch a Monet? If he punched a Rothko, I'd understand. Am I right, art majors?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I don't care for Mark Rothko or Jackson Pollock. That impressionist stuff started with Marcel Duchamp. I'm getting more cerebral, but I'm out of here in nine days so if I want to talk about Marcel Duchamp, I'll do it. And I won't do any more jokes about Taylor Swift breaking up with all those dudes.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I want to check my Twitter feed now to see if anyone's angry at me for that Rothko comment.

name: David Letterman
monologue: On CBS tonight we are following the great holiday special, "Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer." Good news: Rudolph is out of rehab and his nose is no longer red.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Umpire Dale Scott recently became the first major league umpire to come out as gay. Well, he says he's out, but another ump said he was safe, so now we have to wait to see what the replay says.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Umpire Dale Scott came out during an interview with Referee magazine. It's a huge shock — you know, that there's something called Referee magazine.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Starbucks is offering a limited number of sterling silver gift cards that cost $200. They say it's a very classy way of saying, "I know nothing about you.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: New research has found that 84 percent of vegetarians and vegans ultimately return to eating meat. It turns out the way animals are treated is nothing compared to how people treat vegetarians.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: A nor'easter is hitting the East Coast right now. Why do we say "nor'easter" instead of "northeaster"? The only people who should be allowed to say "nor'easter" are people who make a living catching and/or processing cod.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: The Weather Channel is calling the winter storm "Damon," after Matt Damon. So if anything bad happens, it's on him.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: At the White House yesterday, they kicked off Computer Science Education Week. Students gave tutorials on computer code and President Obama sat down and wrote one. All his program does is draw a box, which he's hoping he can crawl into and hide in for the rest of his term.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Every year Americans spend millions of dollars on Christmas gifts for their pets, which makes no sense to me. Your pet doesn't know it's Christmas. In fact, your pet doesn't even know it's a pet, so giving your cat a sweater is about as useful as giving your microwave a hat.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: A flight headed from San Francisco to Phoenix had to make an emergency landing in L.A. today after a passenger gave birth midflight. The parents called the birth a miracle while the airline called it a second carry-on.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: The woman gave birth in the middle of a flight. I'm happy to report that the mother and child are doing fine, while the guy who was sitting next to her is not.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: A church in Alabama will start hosting their Sunday services at Buffalo Wild Wings so they can reach a wider audience. And no audience is wider than the people who eat at Buffalo Wild Wings.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Meryl Streep is on the program tonight. I like to throw her a little work whenever I can.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Time magazine announced its person of the year. It's health workers who treat Ebola. That's a person of the year. Time magazine told the health workers, “No need to pick up your award, we'll mail it to you."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A woman on a Southwest Airlines flight gave birth to a baby. As soon as he was born, the baby said, "I had more leg room in the womb."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Reindeer populations are falling fast, according to a study. We are three years away from Santa using Uber.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The General Mills cereal Cheerios will soon come out in new flavors like quinoa. The CEO of General Mills said the new flavor is in response to an overwhelming demand by no one, absolutely no one.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Time magazine has named Ebola healthcare workers as their person of the year. The Ebola workers were very excited when Time magazine gave them the news — via Skype.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Today Malala Yousafzai and Kailash Satyarthi received the Nobel Peace Prize. And they’re giving an honorable mention to whoever has to announce them.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Kim Kardashian said recently that she gained weight while she was pregnant because God was punishing her for being “so hot.” Though if God is making more Kardashians, I think WE’RE the ones being punished.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Time magazine has named “Ebola Fighters” the 2014 Person of the Year. The Ebola fighters said they were honored to be chosen and look forward to the ceremony. Then Time said, "Oh no, we'll just mail them to you."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Facebook revealed that Ebola was the most popular Facebook topic in the U.S. this year, with the World Cup coming in sixth. So welcome to America, where even Ebola is more popular than soccer.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: President Obama was talking about the new report on CIA interrogation techniques and praised our country’s ability to quote, “face our imperfections, make changes, and do better.” Which sounds less like a speech on torture and more like the comments on a kindergartner's report card.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Jeb Bush’s brother Neil said that their mother has “come around” to the idea of Jeb running for president in 2016. Because if there's anything that says you're qualified to be president, it's your own mom saying, “I guess you could do it."

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Congress goes on recess starting tomorrow night. By the way, that's all you need to know about Congress. They get recess. A bunch of middle-aged adults get three weeks off to play kickball?

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Time magazine named their person of the year today. It was not a member of Congress.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: This year, the person — it's persons, and those persons are the Ebola fighters. The people who were on the front lines, working to keep Ebola contained. I think it's a very good choice. Congratulations, guys. I'd love to shake your hands, but you know . . .

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: This will be the first time an acceptance speech has included the phrase, "We couldn't have done it without Ebola."

name: David Letterman
monologue: Welcome to "The Late Show," ladies and gentlemen. I'm Dave Letterman. Just another lame duck.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The Justice Department ruled that Native American tribes are allowed to grow and sell marijuana on reservations. This decision was hailed as a victory by Native American leader Giggling Eagle.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: This morning, due to a massive storm, at least 150,000 people in San Francisco were left without power. Of course, people in San Francisco without power are usually called Republicans.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: According to a new study, almost 300,000 tons of plastic are currently floating in the world's oceans. About 200,000 tons of that plastic are discarded Bruce Jenner faces.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: There's a holiday gift giving trend that's supposedly on the rise this year called self-gifting. I don't know why everything has to have a term. Didn't that used to be called shopping?

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: It's OK to buy a gift for yourself. But buying a gift and wrapping it for yourself, that's pathetic.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: For lunch today, I gifted myself a roast beef sandwich.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I haven't figured out gift cards. It's kind of like saying I care about you, but not enough to leave the line at Albertson's to find a real gift.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Nothing costs exactly the amount on the gift card. If it's less, you wind up with a credit for like $3, which you'll never use. If it's more, then you're partly buying your own gift.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Here in New York City they have what they call a Santa pub crawl. And like 30,000 Santas, early in the morning, start going from bar to bar to bar, all day long. Last year it was won by a guy from Kenya.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Joe Biden will assist in the 35th annual lighting of the National Menorah at the White House. When he heard that, Smokey Bear said, “Hold my calls. This is not gonna end well.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: This week Biden said that he will decide on a potential 2016 presidential campaign by the spring or the summer. Then he said, “Whichever comes first.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: During his weekly address, Pope Francis assured the crowd that all animals go to heaven. Then cats said, “Have you met us?”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Golden Globe nominations were announced, but some people are upset that “The Walking Dead” and “Modern Family” were snubbed. It’s OK. President Obama has issued an executive action granting them all a path to a nomination.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Do you know what I hate? People say "Craig, you're retiring." Whoa, I'm not retiring. I am just not doing this crap anymore.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I'm not retiring. Dave's retiring. I have more to do. I will probably do ads for local car dealers.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: You have got to figure that if they bring back "Hollywood Squares" I'll be in there. I'm not saying center square. I'm not saying that.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I wish I had more time to do the monologue. But if you want jokes, there are plenty of other middle-aged white guys telling jokes on TV. It's not like, "If only there was a middle-aged white guy telling jokes. There is plenty of that."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Some people are criticizing the new movie "Exodus" for casting the part of Moses with a white actor. They're also not thrilled about the scene where Moses leads the Israelites out of Egypt driving a Prius.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Today in Washington, D.C., several government buildings were left without power. Of course, the White House will be without power for two more years.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Sy Berger, the designer of modern baseball cards, has died. He will be laid to rest in a shoe box somewhere in an attic.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: In a remote village in Alaska, their one mailman quit. He said the sad environment and icy working conditions left him so miserable he had to walk away. Wait, sorry, that's what I said because it's my last week in this dump.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: YouTube has revealed their 10 most watched videos of the year. May I be the first to say, "Congratulations, cats."

name: David Letterman
monologue: Today is the busiest package transporting day of the entire holiday season. UPS today will handle 585 million packages. They don't deliver them, they just handle them.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Over the weekend the co-chair of Sony Entertainment broke her silence about the recent hacking scandal to apologize for some offensive emails she sent about President Obama. In response, Obama said, “Don't worry. I secretly read those emails months ago."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The world's largest travel guide publisher has declared Queens, New York, the best place in the U.S. to visit next year. And if you don't believe it, neither does anyone who lives in Queens.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: New York City Mayor Bill de Blasio recently installed a fence around Gracie Mansion for privacy and security concerns. De Blasio wants to make sure the wrong person doesn't get into the mayor's mansion — while New Yorkers said, “Too late.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Next year, Iowa will become the first state to offer residents an app that allows them to use smartphones as their driver's license. That way you can have the one thing you lose most on the thing you lose the second most.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Sony was the victim of a massive cyber attack from hackers presumed to be based in North Korea. In an embarrassing email, a producer called Angelina Jolie a minimally talented spoiled brat. Which makes this all seem like a high school drama more than an international act of cyber terrorism.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Angelina Jolie, meanwhile, is now unable to promote her new movie, not because of this controversy with Sony, but because she's got chicken pox. But that is some timing. Now she doesn't have to go out and answer questions about Sony.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: It is kind of funny that Jolie directed a movie about a guy who survived a plane crash, got lost at sea, and was held in a Japanese prison camp, and she cannot promote it because she has chicken pox. I mean, put on a turtleneck and get out there.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: In London magic mushrooms were discovered growing at Buckingham Palace in Queen Elizabeth's garden. You know, I was wondering why she knighted Jerry Garcia. And that's probably why she changes the guards every hour. She's completely paranoid.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Producers at Sony say that hackers have gotten a hold of a script for the upcoming James Bond sequel. Although if you really want to know what happens in the new James Bond movie, just watch every other James Bond movie.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Yesterday the prime minister of Haiti announced his resignation after several days of protests. Said the prime minister, "Haitians gonna hate."

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: A man was recently admitted to the hospital for surgery after doctors discovered he still had surgical scissors in his stomach from a procedure performed 12 years ago. Said his new doctor, "The surgery was a success. Now where are my keys?"

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Lindsay Lohan says she wants to move to London permanently. It's a perfect fit because she already drives on the wrong side of the road.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Among the top Google searches of 2014 were Ebola and the movie "Frozen." One leaves you with something highly infectious that's impossible to get out of your system. The other is Ebola.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The hackers who hacked into Sony have leaked the upcoming script for the new James Bond movie. Some of the executives said the news left them shaken but not stirred.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Russia has named Vladimir Putin its man of the year for the 15th year in a row. Putin got 143 million votes and the guy he was up against got killed in a mysterious boating accident. The boat was in a warehouse.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A "Walking Dead" spinoff is going to be set right here in Los Angeles. The zombies are expected to do the two things that people in L.A. refuse to do — walk and eat meat.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Jeb Bush announced today on the Internet that he may run for president. The next presidential election could be Bush vs. Clinton. It will be like 1992 all over again except I won't be in rehab.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: What is Jeb Bush's full name? Jebediah? Jebaroni?

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Things were very different back in 1992. There was unrest in the Middle East, we had a gridlocked Congress, and everybody was talking about Bill Cosby.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The Danes are causing a bit of trouble. The kingdom of Denmark claimed the North Pole as their own. Hey, you can't just reach out and take something if you want it, Denmark. That's Russia's job.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Guess who's running for president? Jeb Bush. Jeb was governor of Florida and he speaks fluent Spanish, which raises the question: What language did his brother speak? What was that?

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: President Obama recently said that his day is all about politics, so in the mornings he likes to watch ESPN. So if you get the feeling he's repeating himself every half hour, that's where he learned it from.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: During an interview, former President George W. Bush discussed his painting hobby and said, “Never paint your wife or your mother.” Then he added, “Because it's almost impossible to get the paint out of their hair.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: This evening marks the beginning of Hanukkah. It's that special tradition where people find out their friend is Jewish and think back on the number of times they've asked them what they were doing for Christmas.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A FedEx truck crashed in New Jersey and spilled packages on the highway. Police would've responded, but when anything falls off a truck in Jersey, it's actually the law to NOT ask questions.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Tonight is the first night of Hanukkah. And who better to celebrate Hanukkah with than our guest tonight — Garth Brooks. Right?

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Hanukkah, for those of you who aren't overly familiar with it, is the reason cashiers say "Happy holidays" instead of "Merry Christmas" when you're at Jamba Juice or wherever.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Here in Los Angeles, we celebrate Hanukkah by lighting a medicinal menorah.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Hanukkah lasting for eight nights is a good idea. When you give gadgets to older relatives, it gives you more time to explain them. I gave my aunt an iPad for her birthday. She uses it as a cigarette tray.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Jeb Bush announced on the Internet that he is exploring a 2016 bid for president. And to increase his chances, he’s going to run as just “Jeb.” He said, “My last name? It’s not important.”

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Tonight is the first night of Hanukkah. Hanukkah lasts for eight nights — unlike Christmas, which lasts for two and a half months.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: President Vladimir Putin has been named Russia’s man of the year. Second place went to “Or else.”

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: This week Kourtney Kardashian gave birth to her third child. So she now holds the record for the most times a Kardashian has experienced labor.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: President Obama announced that he's going to reopen diplomatic relations with Cuba. He wants to act before Seth Rogen makes a movie about Castro.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The Dalai Lama said there should be no more Dalai Lamas after his death. That's particularly bad news for his son, Steve Lama.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new report says ISIS is trying to recruit professionals like doctors, engineers, and accountants. Sorry, kids, even ISIS says they're not hiring liberal arts majors.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The White House announced plans to begin normalizing relations with Cuba — this as we're awkwardizing relations with Russia.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The Pope is 78 today — old enough to watch CBS.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Cardinals threw the Pope a surprise party today. They hid behind his hat.

name: David Letterman
monologue: You probably heard about the big prisoner swap with Cuba. A man who has been incarcerated in Havana for five years is back home in the United States. And we sent them some prisoners. The deal still has to be approved by President Obama and Bud Selig.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Today President Obama announced that the U.S. is working to improve its relationship with Cuba in an effort to normalize full diplomatic relations. For instance, today they released one of our prisoners and in return we sent back one of their shortstops.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The White House will ease diplomatic relations with Cuba. When asked how he’ll celebrate, Obama said, “Smoke a Cuban cigar, no I mean smoke a regular cigarette — oh, I’ll just have some water, I guess, I don’t know.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Despite Russia's move to raise interest rates this week, the value of the ruble has continued to crash. Russia's economy is so bad, Edward Snowden had to put government secrets on Craigslist.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: In an interview, President Obama said he recently deejayed a small dance party at the White House. Obama has a lot in common with deejays. He takes requests and then completely ignores them.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Sony hackers are threatening to attack theaters that show Seth Rogen's new comedy about an attempt on North Korean dictator Kim Jong Un's life. In response, the big theater chains won't show the movie. They should be ashamed of themselves. The idea that there are North Korean terror cells in the U.S. is ridiculous. If there are any North Koreans in America, that's only because they escaped.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: After the theaters backed out, Sony decided to cancel the release of the movie entirely and nobody knows if the movie will be seen. The only way we're ever going to see it is to hack into Sony. If only there was a group that knew how to do that.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: If the North Koreans are going to stop one of our movies being shown, why couldn't it be "Love Actually," which my wife and her friends have in our living room every Christmas?

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: The message this sends is that if you really scare us, we'll do what you want. Poor Seth Rogen. I heard he's so stressed out by this that he's been smoking marijuana.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: A new poll about the 2016 election shows that just 27 percent of voters would be likely to support Chris Christie. And only 4 percent of chairs.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: After closing their final session, the outgoing 113th Congress has an approval rating of just 16 percent. To give you some perspective, Cosby is at 17.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Today a trailer was released for a new documentary about the Backstreet Boys. Unfortunately it was the one they were living in.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: A Salvation Army bell ringer in Virginia was injured when an 87-year-old man accidentally ran him over. He was taken to the hospital once the applause died down.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: It is officially one week until Christmas. That means if you're a guy, you have six days until you have to start shopping.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: We're having our office Christmas party tonight. Just like last year, I'm going to get drunk, make a fool of myself, and then go to the office Christmas party.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: Tomorrow night will be my final night hosting this show. 'Twas the night before I finished and all through CBS employees are stealing office supplies.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: One year from today, the new "Star Wars" movie opens. Mark my words — I'll be there at that movie, probably selling popcorn.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The "Star Wars" movie is coming out. Disney has kept the details of the movie under wraps because they're not Sony.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The new “Hobbit” movie opened. Hobbits are tiny creatures that speak a funny language. We need them more than ever now that "Honey Boo Boo" is over. And it's the last time we'll see Bilbo and Gandalf and Blitzen and Fido and Boomer and Jar-Jar.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Sony has canceled the big Seth Rogen movie, "The Interview." North Koreans hacked their email so Sony said, "Now we can't show anybody the movie." I'm disappointed. I think this is the wrong thing to do. And I hear in the film Meryl Streep is great as Kim Jong Un.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Sony Pictures has canceled the release of “The Interview” due to continued threats from hackers. This means the hackers have accomplished their goal of making everyone in the world want to see “The Interview.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Everyone’s weighing in on Sony’s cancellation of “The Interview.” Mitt Romney suggested the film should be released online for free. Donald Trump said the studio has no courage or guts. Chris Christie said, “Either way, I'm having a large bucket of popcorn.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: During a recent interview, President Obama revealed that his favorite movie this year was “Boyhood.” It makes sense. If there's one thing Obama can identify with, it's aging several years over the course of a couple of hours.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: President Obama said his favorite movie this year was “Boyhood.” When asked what his second-favorite movie was, he said, “'The Interview.' No, definitely not 'The Interview.' I didn’t see 'The Interview.'”

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Star Wars: Episode VII comes out exactly one year from today — as long as we don't get threats from Darth Vader.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Christmas is only one week from tonight. That means you better start practicing you're "Oh my God, I love it" face.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Christmas is a strange holiday. It's Jesus' birthday. I didn't get him anything.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Nobody knows Jesus' exact birthday because he refuses to sign up for Facebook.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: President Obama announced yesterday that he's pardoning 12 convicted felons. Political experts say the move could have huge implications for your fantasy football teams.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Russian President Vladimir Putin said at a press conference today that it was too early to decide if he will run for re-election in 2018. But he says it’s not too early to decide how much he wins by.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: The Kris and Bruce Jenner divorce was made official today. They ask only that the media allow them to handle this family matter publicly.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: An olive oil bar has opened in Brooklyn. It offers more than 40 different kinds of olive oil. If you'd like to know more, wait until your girlfriend drags you there.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Do you remember when you found out there was no Santa Claus? I was so upset I didn't think I'd be able to do the show.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The White House hosted its annual Hanukkah party and everything was going great until Biden pulled on a rabbi's beard and said, "You're not Santa."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The U.S. is re-establishing relations with Cuba. But before President Obama can lift the embargo, it will need approval from the Republican-controlled Congress — or as Republicans who called Obama said, "Close, but no cigar."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: It is rumored that Kanye West spent $74,000 on Christmas presents for his little baby daughter, North. Then North said, "Somebody get a picture of his face when I just play with the boxes."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Graceland is going to auction off Elvis Presley's first-ever recordings from 1953 — or as people now coming to America from Cuba put it, "Whoa! What's that hot new sound?"

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: This is the last show, of course, of "The late Late Show." I really didn't know what to do. I thought I'd do a monologue. Then I thought: Well why? I don't have anything else left to say.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: The people that made this show are you. You came to a show that — let's be honest, a bit of a fixer-upper. And it kind of stayed that way.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I think that we've managed to do here is make something that wasn't here before. So in that sense maybe it is a piece of art. It didn't exist. Now it does and you'll be able to find it forever on YouTube or wherever. No, sorry. What I meant to say is the CBS website.

name: Craig Ferguson
monologue: I wanted to do this show and now we've done this show. And if you will indulge me in whatever I do next I'd be very grateful because my kids are still young.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: During a recent Q & A with children, first lady Michelle Obama said that what she wants for Christmas is to sleep in late. Which is why this year Biden promised not to jump on her bed when it's time to open presents.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Google has found that Ouija boards are one of this year's most popular toys. You know, because it wasn't bad enough dealing with your LIVING relatives.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Everybody celebrates holidays differently. This year many people are traveling to theme parks. They're going to events like Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party and the Dr. Seuss-inspired Grinchmas Who-liday Spectacular. And of course, the most popular event — go play while mommy and daddy drink.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: KFC in Japan will continue its tradition of offering customers a Christmas dinner, which includes chicken, wine, cake, and champagne. For no extra charge, you can tell the cashier how you didn't see your life ending up like this.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Today is January 5. I still have quite a lot of last-minute shopping to do.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Tonight is our best show of 2015. If you have tickets to tomorrow's show, I feel sorry for you. It's all downhill after tonight.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: At the Cowboys football game Chris Christie was hugging Jerry Jones. It was right after Jones said "Let's get some hot wings."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Plans are underway to build an NFL stadium in Los Angeles. That's good news because it's been at least a decade since L.A. had a sports team not to care about.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: General Mills has announced that they're making a new flavor of Cheerios made from quinoa. And at the bottom there's a special prize — Cheerios not made with quinoa.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Joe Biden went to Brazil in an effort to try and repair America's relationship with their government. Biden said, “It's great to be here in the Amazon. I've always wanted to see where all the books come from.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Democratic Senator Harry Reid is expected to make a full recovery after he was exercising with a resistance band that snapped, causing him to fall. The good news is he's fine. The bad news is there's no video of it.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The Jets are expected to name a new coach this week, and the leading candidate is reportedly former Buffalo Bills coach Doug Marrone. A lot of people are upset about the news — mostly Doug Marrone.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Kanye West teamed up with Paul McCartney on his recently released single, “Only One.” When asked what it was like working with a music legend and pioneer, Kanye said, “I'm sure he was pretty intimidated.”

name: David Letterman
monologue: Well, the holidays are over and the jolly fat man is gone. I'm talking about Rex Ryan, coach of the Jets.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: One of the new gadgets at the Consumer Electronics Show is a belt that tells the person wearing it when it's time to lose weight. Another device is a pair of jeans that says, "Hey, try a salad."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new study has found that watching Fox News can make you more conservative and watching MSNBC can make you more liberal. And watching CNN can make you think that no plane has ever safely reached its destination.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Mark Zuckerberg has an ambition to read something new every two weeks. First up on Zuckerberg's reading list — all your private Facebook messages.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Scientists have made a pill that tricks you into thinking your body is full. Unfortunately, it's filled with mashed potatoes and has 8,500 calories.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Sportscaster Jim Rome has angered marching bands across the country after he called them “dorks” on Twitter. Marching bands are crafting a reply, but it’s taking them forever to spell it out on the field.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: While vacationing in Hawaii this weekend, actor Rob Lowe used a jet ski to help rescue passengers on a sailboat that had run aground. And “Creepy” Rob Lowe just watched through his binoculars.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Lindsay Lohan was recently diagnosed with a rare mosquito-transmitted disease called Chikungunya. And the mosquito was diagnosed with alcohol poisoning.

name: Jimmy Fallon

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: This week, Dr. Oz will respond to critics who believe he should not be giving medical advice on his show. People will be watching his response closely — especially Dr. Phil.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: It is Earth Day. I bet the Earth got so many messages.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: The first Earth Day took place in 1970. At the rate we are going, the last one should be soon.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Manny Pacquiao is on the show tonight. On May 7, Manny faces Floyd Mayweather in one of the most anticipated bouts ever. He is from the Philippines and a national hero. I wonder if anyone in the Philippines is rooting for Mayweather. Probably one jerk who nobody likes.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: We also have Dr. Phil tonight. Dr. Phil once said that no matter how flat you make a pancake, it's still got two sides. So not only does Dr. Phil understand the human condition, he understands breakfast too.

monologue: Baseball slugger Barry Bonds has been cleared of all charges. He was involved in performance-enhancing drugs. The guy tested positive for more things than a pint of Blue Bell ice cream.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Arnold Schwarzenegger has a new movie that focuses on a zombie apocalypse. It takes place in an empty wasteland with no living beings. Just like the movie theater where it's playing.

monologue: Doctors in India have removed 140 coins, 150 needles, and several nuts, bolts, and batteries from the stomach of a man suffering from abdominal pain. Someone should give that guy a medal. Actually, you know what? Don't give him a medal.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Students at a Catholic girls school in England are reportedly being taught that sex outside of marriage can destroy your soul and make your body sick. While sex inside of marriage just destroys your soul.

monologue: Chinese scientists have edited the DNA of human embryos for the first time, sparking concerns that it could lead to designer children. So, now even people are made in China.

monologue: Today is "Take Our Daughters and Sons to Work Day." Or as Woody Allen calls it, "Take Your Wife to Work Day."

name: James Corden
monologue: I did not take my children to work because my oldest is 4 years old, and frankly he is already far too mature to be hanging around this office.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: At the White House yesterday, a little girl actually asked first lady Michelle Obama how old she is. Michelle answered, "Old enough to put you on the No Fly List, sweetheart.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: It’s being reported that Google spent over $5 million on lobbying just during the first quarter of this year. You’d think Google wouldn't really need to lobby politicians. All they have to say is, “We have your search history. Do what we tell you.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: New York Mayor Bill de Blasio has been positioning himself to challenge Hillary Clinton for the Democratic nomination. Hillary once developed a program to deliver rural healthcare, while de Blasio once dropped a groundhog on its head.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: I read that many minor league baseball players have been caught using steroids over the past few years. But apparently, not ENOUGH steroids.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Today is Take Our Daughters and Sons to Work Day, also known as No Work Gets Done Day. It is a great opportunity to teach your kids why you come home miserable every night.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I wonder if anyone has ever been fired on "take your kid to work day." Just imagine, "Ron, will you and your daughter step into my office please?" That would be a lesson about what it is like to work.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Everybody seems to think they're safe from earthquakes if they don't live in California. According to the Seismological Society of America, half of Americans are threatened by earthquakes. We just celebrated Earth Day and now it wants to kill us.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: If you have never been through an earthquake, I think the worst thing is not that it is happening. It's that when it starts you don't know how long it will go or how bad it will be. It's like a celebrity marriage.

name: David Letterman
monologue: Mayor de Blasio wants to eliminate garbage. He believes New York City produces way too much garbage. Well, heck, forget about producing too much garbage. What about late-night talk shows?

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The royal baby is expected to arrive sometime this weekend, and some people are actually camping outside the hospital in hopes of seeing it. So if you want to be the first to find out what the royal baby looks like, just look at a photo of any baby.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: According to a survey from the Physical Activity Council, Americans are the least active they’ve been since 2007. Some say it's because there's more technology, while others say it's because winter now lasts 11 months a year. It's snowing here a week before May.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: That's right, Americans are more inactive than ever. To which Netflix said, "You're welcome."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Miami Dolphins lineman A.J. Francis just tweeted that he has signed up to be an Uber driver during the offseason. But since he's with the Dolphins he can only drive 15 yards before he has to punt.

name: James Corden
monologue: It's official. I genuinely cannot keep up with the Kardashians.

name: James Corden
monologue: In an interview with Diane Sawyer, Bruce Jenner made it known that he would like to be identified as a woman. I was watching it with my wife, and she turned to me and said that watching this had given her hope that one day I might fully transition into becoming a man.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The big story is Bruce Jenner. In last week's interview, Jenner said he's a woman who is transitioning his body from male to female, and he's also a conservative Republican. Bruce said he looks forward to bashing Obamacare as soon as he finishes using it.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: The NBA playoffs are underway. Or as the Lakers call it, time to golf.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A U.N. study claims the happiest country in the world is Switzerland. When asked why they're so happy, Swiss people couldn't answer because their hands were counting money and their mouths were full of chocolate.

name: David Letterman
monologue: I have only a few weeks left here on the show. So I was thinking that I had better hurry up and use my sick days.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: In a two-hour interview last Friday, Bruce Jenner told ABC's Diane Sawyer, “For all intents and purposes, I'm a woman.” At which point, Joe Biden ran in and started giving Bruce a shoulder rub.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Bruce Jenner declared he is a woman and a Republican. In other words, the GOP finally found someone who might be able to beat Hillary.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Many believe that Hillary Clinton was channeling President Obama during her recent speech in New York City. She focused on equality, justice, and how hard it was for her growing up as a young black man in Hawaii.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: I watched Diane Sawyer's interview with Bruce Jenner on Friday night. I think he came off very well. He went from being a boring man to a very charming woman. We might have found our next "Bachelorette."

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: The most shocking part of the interview for me was when Bruce Jenner said there was only one full-length mirror in the Kardashian house.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: Jenner also identified himself as a conservative Republican. He said he believes that John Boehner and Mitch McConnell will support him and advocate for transgender issues. Yeah, of course they will. They're probably having the buttons printed as we speak.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
monologue: It turns out after all of these years that instead of the Kardashians we should have been keeping up with Bruce.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Dr. Oz defended himself from critics last week by saying that his television program is not a medical show. It’s just that he didn’t think anyone would watch a show called “Mr. Oz.”

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: There’s a new dating app that pairs attractive females with generous males who will fly them to foreign countries for first dates. If you’d like to know more, tune in to next week’s "Dateline."

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: A new survey has found that people in Ireland tell an average of four white lies per day. And three of them are, “I’m fine to drive home.”

name: David Letterman
monologue: To save energy, New York City is now dimming the lights of the skyscrapers and the skyline at night. There's a bad side to this. If you need Batman, you have to text him.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Due to civil unrest in Baltimore, tomorrow's game between the Orioles and the White Sox will be played to an empty stadium. When asked for comments, players on the Milwaukee Brewers said, "You get used to it."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new study reveals that one-third of babies in the U.S. have used a smartphone. Yeah, and one-third of babies in China have MADE a smartphone.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Prince William's pregnant wife, Kate Middleton, is past her due date. Doctors may have to induce labor. To speed up the birth, doctors have been telling the baby, "Come on out. You will never have to work a day in your life."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Bruce Jenner will be getting his own reality show. Unfortunately, as a woman Jenner will be making only 70 percent of what he made on his last reality show.

name: James Corden
monologue: There are rumors that Leonardo DiCaprio is now on Tinder. Leo, buddy, please give the rest of humanity a fighting chance. There should be a ban on handsome movie stars on Tinder. Tinder's not for you. Tinder's for me.

name: James Corden
monologue: Nicki Minaj made a 13-year-old boy's dream come true when she performed at his bar mitzvah over the weekend. I'm a grown man with my own TV show and I can't get her to perform.

name: James Corden
monologue: How many people were at that bar mitzvah — 300? Nicki, we have almost double that watching this show right now. Think about what this could do for your career.

name: James Corden
monologue: Imagine being the kid at that school who's having the next bar mitzvah. How do you compete with that? His friends will say, "What, you're having a magician? He'd better reach into his hat and pull out Beyoncé."

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Hillary Clinton wrote an Op-Ed for a paper in Iowa about her plans to help the middle class. Middle-class Americans said, “Why didn't you just say that in a speech?” and she said, “Because I charge $200,000 for a speech.”

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: During a recent press conference, former President Jimmy Carter said he could never run for president today because he doesn’t have a lot of money. Well, that and the fact that he's the famously bad president Jimmy Carter.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Blackberry is being criticized after it misspelled the word “won” in an ad celebrating a design award. Instead of w-o-n they put o-n-e. Blackberry apologized for the spelling mistake and promised the person responsible has been fried.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: The new Apple Watch officially launched today. There's a new trend — people cutting actual apples and strapping them to their wrists in celebration of the Apple Watch. And if you shop at Whole Foods, it actually ends up costing as much as the real thing.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Hillary Clinton has temporarily changed her campaign logo to rainbow colors in support of marriage equality. Of course, her idea of marriage equality is both of you should get to be president.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: While covering the earthquake in Nepal this week, CNN correspondent Sanjay Gupta helped medical personnel perform brain surgery. Gupta said he was excited to work with brains again after being at CNN for so long.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Scientists have discovered that Tyrannosaurus Rex may have had a vegetarian cousin. Man, it must suck to have a vegetarian in the family when your arms are too short to cover your ears.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Starbucks has a new S'mores Frappuccino, which became available today. It's perfect for those people looking to gain s'more weight.

name: David Letterman
monologue: It's a beautiful day in New York City. It's sunny and 73, like me.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: In Baltimore, the Orioles and the Chicago White Sox played a game today in a completely empty stadium. It was the first major sporting event to be played in an empty stadium, unless you count every professional soccer game in America.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Tomorrow is the start of the NFL draft. This year it will be simulcast on ESPN and Court TV.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: A new presidential poll reveals that Democrats have the edge among voters under 30. The good news for Republicans is that there's only six people under 30 who actually vote.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Ford has recalled almost 600,000 vehicles for steering problems. Owners are being told to bring their cars in as close to the dealership as they can get it.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: Hillary Clinton gave a speech at Columbia University this afternoon. She ended it the way Clintons always end their speeches, by saying, “That’ll be $200,000.”

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: It was such a nice day today that President Obama left the White House and went for a walk around the neighborhood. Even more amazing, THIS is the first the Secret Service is hearing about it.

name: Seth Meyers
monologue: A company is working on a new selfie stick shaped like a human arm so users won’t look like they’re alone in pictures. Instead you’ll just look like a completely normal person who’s carrying around a human arm.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders is expected to announce tomorrow that he is running for president, making him Hillary Clinton’s only Democratic challenger so far. Or as Hillary put it, "Oooo, appetizers!"

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: There is a new reality show on CBS where a family must decide whether to keep $100,000 in a briefcase or give it away to another family. The show's called, “We'll Keep the Briefcase.” It's the first 10-second-long show in history.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: A 91-year-old woman in the U.K. recently got engaged to her 102-year-old boyfriend, which would make them the oldest newlyweds in the world. They're really happy and said they can’t wait to spend the rest of their week together.

name: James Corden
monologue: A family cleaning out their grandparents' attic in Florida found a wooden box containing a mummified pirate's hand on a map with gold coins. It really kills the romanticism of the whole pirate thing for me, when the treasure isn't under an "X" on the beach, but in the attic of a two-story condo in Florida.

name: James Corden
monologue: A treasure chest full of gold pirate coins may be cool, but do you know what I have in my attic? Family heirlooms and pictures of all my loved ones — and isn't that the real treasure? No, no it isn't. The real treasure is a treasure chest full of gold pirate coins.

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: Ford just recalled almost 1 million cars for steering problems and because the doors fly open. This explains Chevrolet's new slogan: "Ford just recalled almost 1 million cars for steering problems and because the doors fly open."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: North Korean dictator Kim Jong Un reportedly has had 15 of his top officials executed. So the lesson here is when Kim Jong Un comes to work with a new haircut, you tell him, "Looking good, Un."

name: Conan O'Brien
monologue: In Oregon, a number of brewers are competing to turn sewer water into beer. The brewer said, "Hey, if Bud Light can do it, we can do it."

name: David Letterman
monologue: Our guest tonight is Michelle Obama, first lady of the United States. She's here to announce her run for president.

name: Jimmy Fallon
monologue: Floyd Mayweather said he will make around $200 million for his fight on Saturday against Manny Pacquiao. Meanwhile, the horse that wins the Kentucky Derby will get an extra carrot.
